The corridor lights varied in brightness. The black-and-white silhouettes walked side by side. As they stepped into the bright light, Lin Xun suddenly reached up and rested a hand on Jiang Qing's shoulder. They turned to look at each other against the light, at an angle.

She slammed down the shutter button, darted back into the room, and shouted herself hoarse. "AHHHH I AM OBSESSED!"

"What are you yelling about?" A colleague asked.

She pressed the phone carefully to her chest before bringing it over for the other person to see. "Look at this. Just look. This black and white pairing, does it not absolutely wreck you? I'm sorry, they are simply too perfect for each other! TOO MATCHING!!!"

"OH MY GOD! Send it to me right now!!!"

chapters.title: Thank You
chapters.content:
Jiang Qing was completely oblivious to the makeup artists' screaming, and only furrowed his brow, looking at Lin Xun. "What are you doing?"

"Isn't this just how Xiao Bai walks?" Lin Xun looked entirely innocent.

"......"

Jiang Qing twitched his mouth, caught him by the hand and doubled him back with a swift fold of his arm, laughed coolly, and said, "Lao Hei hits him all the time too."

Lin Xun remained unmoved and let himself be frogmarched all the way to the filming location.

The director couldn't help breaking into applause. "Wonderful, wonderful. They got into character this fast, even their entrance is this inspired."

Jiang Qing said nothing as he let go, and got ready for the shoot. The opening shot was of the man in black pulling Bai Wuchang out of a crowd.

Bai Wuchang, absolutely without a care in the world, was still gnawing on a chicken leg, grease all over his mouth.

The man in black accidentally got some on himself, and with visible disgust sent him tumbling down. The two of them came to a stop at the top of the mountain.

Lin Xun rolled around twice on the ground, then pulled out the carefully protected chicken leg, and took a disgruntled bite. "You could have told me you were coming to find me. Have you eaten?"

Jiang Qing reached out with a ferocious expression and swatted at his head, but at the very last second turned it into a pat instead, with a face full of exasperation. "Fool. You nearly ended up as someone's wife."

"What does a wife do?" Lin Xun held up the chicken leg and blinked with perfect innocence. "Can't I be someone's wife?"

Jiang Qing sat down across from him. "Of course you can't. That defies the natural order of things."

"Ha! I am from the underworld, what do I know about the natural order or not! This is me helping people out! I would be their wife, he'd be happy and I'd be happy, isn't that what you call a good deed for the day......"

He didn't get to finish. Jiang Qing shoved the chicken leg straight into his mouth and plugged him up, and said in warning, "This is not where you belong......"

Lin Xun turned his head, knocked back the chicken leg in a few bites, wiped his mouth with his sleeve, and suddenly pointed upward. "Wow the stars are so beautiful!"

"Listen to me......" Jiang Qing said, at his wit's end.

"I'm not listening, I'm not listening."

"You listen to me! The stars hang in the sky, and you should have gone back to the underworld by now......"

"The stars are so beautiful. I want to come back and see them again!"

"The people in the underworld are waiting for you. You have companions there. And the old King Yan is still waiting for you to do your job......"

"Your fault I didn't eat enough."

The two of them talked entirely past each other for a long stretch, neither willing to concede.

Jiang Qing's brow creased deeper and deeper, and he closed the distance step by step, his voice gradually rising. "You were never meant to belong to the mortal world. But the people here need you. Do you understand?!"

The mouth on Lin Xun that had been going nonstop finally fell quiet. He stared at the other person, a hint of wronged feeling in his eyes. He looked around, then lifted his head to look at him again. "I don't care!"

With that, he seized the back of Jiang Qing's hand and sank his teeth in.

Jiang Qing sucked in a sharp breath, and kicked him clean off.

But Lin Xun curled nimbly at the waist, twisting and squirming where he stood, and looked back with a gloating grin. "You can't hit me, nyah, nyah, nyah!"

"Fine, I wash my hands of you! Be someone's wife if you want, eat chicken legs till you drop!" The vein at Jiang Qing's temple pulsed, and he turned and walked away.

Lin Xun froze, staring at his retreating back, and then in one lunging pounce brought the person flat on the ground beneath him.

Jiang Qing struggled and couldn't get free. The two of them looked at each other face to face, each searching the other's expression for some kind of answer.

Lin Xun looked at him with sincerity. "Who exactly are you? Why does my heart hurt so much every time you leave?"

Jiang Qing gritted his teeth. "...... I am your father!"

"Father?!" Lin Xun was dumbstruck. "What's a father? I've never heard of that before. My big brother said he found me when he was taking a piss."

"......" Jiang Qing used the moment of Lin Xun's bewilderment to shove him off, smoothed out his hair with aristocratic composure, and gave him a withering sidelong glance. "The eldest is like a father. Does that not make me your father?"

Lin Xun counted on his fingers, and then it suddenly dawned on him. He threw himself at Jiang Qing and cried with abandon. "Father! My dear father!"

"Cut." The director called out.

Jiang Qing immediately switched back to his usual expression, and looked at Lin Xun. "What did you just call me? It was quite nice to hear. Say it again."

"Dream on." The voice was a little raspy.

Jiang Qing paused, and looked at him sideways. Two teardrops were still sitting on his cheeks, and his eyes were red.

He immediately broke into laughter, sitting right there on the floor slapping the ground. "Your tears are extraordinary. You can summon them just like that?"

Lin Xun wrinkled his nose and shot him a glance, the red at the corners of his eyes giving him the air of a disgruntled wife glaring at a "dead husband."

Jiang Qing laughed even harder. He reached out and took the tissue someone handed him, raised it, and then suddenly went completely still.

Hmm? Does he deserve me doing this personally?

"Are you going to do it or not?" Lin Xun said impatiently, seeing him holding the tissue and not moving.

"Oh." Jiang Qing gave him a perfunctory wipe, telling himself this was his contribution to world peace.

After that came the post-production edit, and Jiang Qing looked over the progress and current state of things.

"What do you think?" Lin Xun stood beside him and asked.

Jiang Qing lowered his voice near his ear. "I think you can't beat me."

"Oh."

Oh?

Was that disappointment or delight?

The two of them turned and walked back to the green room. He added a beat later, "Though you don't need to feel bad about yourself. You're still young, after all."

Lin Xun reminded him, "I'm a full three years older than you."

He shot back without thinking, "A woman three years older than her man is...... is ...... is like she's perched upon a golden sedan chair!"

"Hah." Lin Xun discovered that in each of these brief stretches they spent together, the frequency with which he laughed was going up. "Jiang Qing, you're really something."

"Not as much as you." Jiang Qing said out of habit, and made his way back into the practice room, walking over to the mirror to look at himself.

Quite handsome indeed.

He admired himself with quiet satisfaction and a slight curve of his lips, then caught Lin Xun's reflection out of the corner of his eye, and let his mouth drop.

How can two such people exist at once! He finally truly understood the torment Zhou Yu had gone through.

Lin Xun, unaware of the peculiar thoughts running through his head, walked forward and stood beside him. He looked down and to the side, and in the light of the makeup mirror, the glow fell perfectly across Jiang Qing's features. From this angle, looking down, Lin Xun spotted a tiny, barely-there indentation just below the outer corner of Jiang Qing's right eye.

Almost without thinking, he reached out his index finger and gave it a small poke.

Jiang Qing startled, turned to look at him, and raised his hand to touch the spot, his gaze sharpening suddenly.

Lin Xun said with apparent concern, "Were you injured there?"

Jiang Qing lowered his eyes, covering everything behind them, and replied in an even, understated tone, "No. Born with it."

"I see. I think it looks quite nice, actually."

Jiang Qing: "A scar looks nice?" You must be half-blind.

The second half of that thought never made it out, cut off as Lin Xun spoke. "They say God places every hardship onto a person. All of yours must have been placed into that mark, which means you'll have no other hardships left in this life."

What a ridiculous thing to say...... and yet Jiang Qing took it seriously. Something in him lifted up, weightless and gentle, then settled softly back down. He stared blankly and asked, "Is that so?"

"Mm. Because you are the most beautiful child in this world." Lin Xun turned up the corner of his mouth, expecting to be roundly scolded. But when Jiang Qing heard those words, his eyes went clear and bright, and a small flame flared up, then quietly died down.

Jiang Qing softened his voice, yet kept it precise. "Thank you."

chapters.title: Big Brother
chapters.content:
After resting for a while, post-production wrapped up and everyone returned to the studio.

Jiang Qing settled back into the mentor's seat, and Su Hongru beside him took the initiative to ask, "So, how was it?"

"It was a refreshing format." He smiled a little. "How about on your end? How was Gao Yuanqiao?"

"Not bad, pretty solid for someone at his level. How did this kid get famous? Never heard of him before. Aren't you two from the same company?"

"I don't know him well either." Jiang Qing was vague. "I don't really watch television or variety shows, so there are a lot of people now I don't recognize."

"Indeed, hard not to feel left behind......"

The two of them commiserated as the audience filed in. Once the on-site director had the room under control, the second half of recording officially got underway.

First they screened Teacher Wen Jiaxin's group. After the playback ended, the live vote was cast, and predictably Wen Jiaxin won.

Then the host invited Jiang Qing and Lin Xun onstage, and the playback of their segment began.

The previous group had been a tear-soaked production, and the audience had barely recovered when this one started. Within two minutes, laughter was already rippling through the room.

Lin Xun glanced at the audience, then looked back at himself and Jiang Qing on screen, and for the first time felt something of the appeal of being onstage.

He turned and looked sideways. Jiang Qing's focused profile was a little dazzling to look at.

Perhaps feeling the gaze, Jiang Qing looked back his way, and those expressive eyes gave him an immediate, lively glare.

He smiled softly and looked away, the corner of his mouth settling into a perfectly measured, captivating curve.

Not far off, the Lavender fans who had been keeping their entire attention on Lin Xun were now screaming internally.

Lin Xun please just end me! That smile is so warm! I'm drowning in that smile! But why is he smiling at Jiang Qing?!

The unknowingly targeted Jiang Qing was none the wiser, his full focus on the screen. It had been a long time since he had filmed anything, and the long-absent feeling of excitement surged up in him, so strong he wanted to cry out for his mother.

But he had to hold it together. The snow-lotus-on-the-mountain image couldn't crack.

The show came to a close, and the audience broke into applause.

In a competition, comedy never left as deep an impression as drama. But Lin Xun hadn't come with the burning ambition to win, and the two of them had simply enjoyed themselves and filmed the scene.

The host walked them through the formalities, letting the audience vote while asking them about their experience, and giving them a chance to rally some support.

Lin Xun said, "It was a pleasure collaborating with Teacher Jiang. He taught me quite a few things I'd never encountered before. Though he's young, both his attitude and his ability earned my genuine admiration. I hope we'll have the chance to collaborate again in the future......"

Jiang Qing: Very official indeed.

But in the next instant, Lin Xun pivoted completely. "So I'd like to ask everyone to vote for Teacher Jiang, so that next time I can come back and continue doing scenes with him."

"......"

Jiang Qing took the microphone. "Don't listen to him. He has genuine acting talent, he trained seriously, and he's a formidable opponent worth respecting. So give all your votes to him, him and only him! One from you, one from me, let's all send him right through to the finals!"

The audience: ......

This is so hard for us.

In the end the audience votes were neck and neck, so it came down to the ten professional judges and the two other mentors.

Professionals have professional eyes, and when all was said and done, Jiang Qing received more votes. Lin Xun, however, earned unanimous praise and recognition from everyone.

The two of them shook hands onstage.

The host Du Yuening watched this historic handshake with a flutter in her chest.

She was very close to doing a little dance on top of two fences right now.

Because Lin Xun had lost the challenge, a cluster of Lavender fans broke into their chant again. "Lin Xun, Lin Xun, one of a kind!"

Lin Xun waved back at them.

Du Yuening said, "Teacher Jiang, is there anything you'd like to say to Lin Xun? Give him some encouragement and a confidence boost!"

Jiang Qing thought it over, then said, "Those girls just now put it quite well. Let me borrow from them."

Learning from someone else's lines, surely those wouldn't trip him up?

He pinched his voice higher, mimicking the pitch of a young girl's voice.

"Lin Xun, Lin Xun, one of a kind!"

"Lin Xun, Lin Xun, best in all mankind!"

"Xun-ge, Xun-ge, sweetest love song!"

The audience erupted. "HAHAHAHA!"

"AHHHH Jiang Qing you are the best! Our chant has been claimed!!!" one Lavender fan yelled.

Lin Xun looked at him sideways and smiled serenely. "Thank you. I genuinely felt encouraged."

Jiang Qing: "You're welcome. Heh heh heh."

The final group was a heavyweight combination of a major mentor and a newly rising actor, with plenty of its own appeal. The outcome was also completely undisputed: Su Hongru won.

Su Hongru spent a long time on stage praising Gao Yuanqiao, then suddenly called Jiang Qing into it. "Right, Jiang Qing, what do you think of him?"

"Oh, yes, you're absolutely right! Gao Yuanqiao, keep it up, we're all rooting for you!"

Gao Yuanqiao was so moved he nearly cried as he bowed to him. "Thank you so much. I've always loved Senior Jiang's work, you've always been my guiding example!"

Jiang Qing was thrown off by his teary-eyed sincerity, and for a moment genuinely couldn't tell if it was heartfelt or performed.

After recording ended, he went back to the green room to pack up. Sang Yi had just opened the door when they found Gao Yuanqiao standing outside.

"Something up?" Jiang Qing asked.

Gao Yuanqiao glanced at him and stepped slightly inside. Both hands clasped behind his back, gripping a piece of paper tightly, he said with nervous uncertainty, "Senior, I......"

"Jiang Qing, heading out?" A voice rang out from somewhere down the corridor, getting closer.

Everyone looked over. Lin Xun was strolling this way with both hands in his pockets, and gave a small start when he spotted Gao Yuanqiao.

"It's not like you're a girl. You don't need to go to the bathroom or go home in a group." Jiang Qing said with exasperation, as though the two women right behind him weren't already doing exactly that.

"I'm by myself. Come on." Lin Xun blinked.

Jiang Qing ignored him and dealt with Gao Yuanqiao first. "Still got something?"

"Yes!" Gao Yuanqiao immediately thrust out a promotional photo of Jiang Qing. "Senior, could I get your autograph?"

Jiang Qing studied it for a moment, puzzled, then signed it for him.

"Thank you so much, Senior!" Gao Yuanqiao held it like treasure, and then pulled out his phone, asking carefully, "Could we also add each other on WeChat? I have a few questions about acting I'd love to ask you. I promise I won't bother you!"

Jiang Qing happily agreed.

The two of them scanned each other's codes, and after they had successfully added each other, Gao Yuanqiao took a respectful step back, said goodbye, and turned and bolted without looking back.

Jiang Qing was now thoroughly baffled.

While he was lost in thought, Lin Xun spoke up to break through his train of thought. "Senior, I want to add you too."

"Don't call me Senior. Stop calling me that."

"Big brother, my Lao Hei big brother, I want to add you." Lin Xun said with complete shamelessness.

Jiang Qing: "......"

The sound of that "big brother" was...... not unpleasant.

Lin Xun was surprised to see him open not WeChat but a blue app, and asked, puzzled, "Alipay? Why are you adding friends on Alipay?"

Obviously to steal energy orbs! What else?

chapters.title: Sharing a Ride
chapters.content:
Jiang Qing got in the car, watched Lin Xun follow right in after him, and quietly marveled at the sheer depth of the man's shamelessness, enough to rival two full layers of a thousand-skin pastry.

But the man had helped him out a few times, and it was only a short ride. Refusing would seem unreasonably petty.

"Drop him off at Bourdain first." Jiang Qing said to Sang Yi.

Shu Tong in the front passenger seat turned around with a smile. "You two seem quite close. You even know where he's staying."

Jiang Qing opened his mouth just about to deny it when Lin Xun was quicker. "We get along."

"We ran into each other at Bourdain before." Jiang Qing pursed his lips and redirected. "When does the show air?"

Shu Tong answered, "Saturday evening next week, eight-thirty."

"Got it."

Seeing how relaxed he looked, Shu Tong asked, "In such a good mood? What are you going to do about your endorsement? Not going to fight for it?"

"I have a plan." Jiang Qing said vaguely.

"What if we let your dad......"

Shu Tong glanced at him with the sentence half-finished, and watched his eyes go suddenly sharp, his whole body radiating a cold stillness.

Even Lin Xun, who had been playing invisible, noticed, and looked over instinctively.

Shu Tong paused, then course-corrected. "Let you cut your hair a little shorter. You never listen, it's almost past your shoulders now."

At that, Jiang Qing relaxed, and said with a grin, "There are still quite a few more recording sessions. There'll definitely be a short-hair character worked in eventually."

"You really are saving money on haircuts." Lin Xun remarked.

Shu Tong laughed. "Isn't that right. And all the money saved on haircuts goes straight into clothes. I tell you, the level of self-absorption on this one is something to behold."

"Cough, cough, cough, cough!" Jiang Qing coughed pointedly to signal there was someone else in the car.

But Shu Tong, completely unbothered, started airing his private life. "He loves being complimented. Acts indifferent on the outside, but inside he's doing a little dance......"

Jiang Qing: "Cough, cough, cough, cough, cough, cough."

"He's also terrified of dogs. The first time he came to my house, my dog scared him into running all over the room. Crying his eyes out, snot running down his face, and once I'd wiped it all away he would still ask: who is the most beautiful child in the whole world? I nearly died laughing."

Lin Xun held it together for exactly one second before something clicked, and he looked at Jiang Qing with a deeply meaningful expression. Earlier in the makeup room, he had apparently said that little thing he used to say to tease his younger cousins...... No wonder Jiang Qing's reaction had been so unexpected.

Jiang Qing shot him a warning glare. "Don't you dare laugh!"

Lin Xun turned to look out the window. The shoulders that were quietly shaking gave him away.

Jiang Qing's face went red. He slapped the back of Shu Tong's seat in outrage. "Stop talking! Stop or I'll stop being friends with you!"

Shu Tong said with a laugh, "Alright, alright, I'll stop."

Lin Xun turned back around, caught Jiang Qing's venomous stare, and without a trace of fear said, "Believe me, you really are the most beautiful child in the world."

"Yi-yi, stop the car. Throw him out!"

Lin Xun smoothed away his smile and changed the subject with perfect naturalness. "Tong-jie, how old was Jiang Qing when you first met him?"

Jiang Qing: Since when is Tong-jie something you just get to call her? You've got some nerve.

Shu Tong was just about to answer when the driver Sang Yi let out a strange little laugh. "Pfft haha."

All three of them: ???

"Haha." Sang Yi said, delighted. "Qing-ge, were you always this funny when you were little?"

All three of them: ......

A reflex arc roughly the diameter of the Earth, that one.

Accompanied by Sang Yi's intermittent bursts of laughter, Shu Tong answered Lin Xun's question. "Very little. Seven or eight years old, I think. Little face all stern, little mouth all pouty, like a tiny adult. He just turned up at my front door and declared he wanted to act, to act for the rest of his life......"

It had all been so long ago that Jiang Qing had no real memory of it. Hearing it mentioned like this out of nowhere gave him a kind of fresh and curious feeling, and he asked, "Was it because I was so incredibly adorable and handsome that you decided to take me on?"

"Don't flatter yourself." Shu Tong said with a dismissive look. "I had an artist under me who was doing well at the time. If someone hadn't asked me to look after you, I wouldn't have bothered taking you on."

Jiang Qing coughed once and said sheepishly, "Your sense of calling as a stepmother is truly on another level."

Shu Tong ignored him and spoke straight to Lin Xun. "Do you know why I've never switched to someone else?"

"Why?" Jiang Qing leaned over to ask.

Shu Tong looked at him out of the corner of her eye and said with a smile, "When I was younger and busiest, I had no time for family. Back then I hadn't gotten pregnant yet either, and my mother-in-law wanted my husband to divorce me. Jiang Qing found out, and this half-grown kid went to my mother-in-law and laid on the flattery so thick, and painted such a picture of the future, that my mother-in-law was just standing there blinking at him in dazzled confusion."

"And also, in all my limited experience, I've never seen anyone who could maintain a childlike heart the way he does. He says things that don't always land well, but that's just someone who means what he says and says what he means. That's all it is."

Jiang Qing felt himself going red. Since when did she just go ahead and praise someone to their face like this!

Your talent management skills are far too polished.

He ended the topic with blunt force. "Tong-jie, keep this up and I'll replace you."

Shu Tong laughed and scolded him briefly, then turned back around. She glanced up at the rearview mirror.

The two of them caught each other's eyes. Lin Xun gave her a slight smile.

Shu Tong smiled back. The truth was, she had brought those things up on purpose.

In all his years in the industry, Jiang Qing had never really had a friend his own age.

During school he had been the center of attention, and most classmates were too intimidated to get close to him. He had had a few good friends at one point, but either they wanted to ride his coattails into something better, or they used him to launch their own careers. A few had even anonymously leaked a string of fabricated scandals about him.

Gradually, Jiang Qing had let go, and stopped letting anyone in. Those inside the industry were not even worth considering.

Just thinking about it made her, as his "stepmother," feel completely worn through worrying.

Lately Jiang Qing had been complimenting Lin Xun every other moment, and even knew where he was staying. Lin Xun, for his part, didn't seem like the type to cause trouble, and more importantly, he seemed to get under Jiang Qing's skin in exactly the right way, drawing out a kind of childlike quality in him.

If it were possible, she would actually quite like for Lin Xun and Jiang Qing to become proper friends.

But clearly, Jiang Qing had no idea what she was thinking, and had no such plan himself. He looked out the window, thinking over what was next.

Getting cast in a television drama was going to be an uphill battle for the foreseeable future. If the company actually agreed to let him sit out, then the next six months wouldn't bring any projects at all, and that six-month void would be very rough to sit through.

His fingers tapped against the window ledge in a steady rhythm. Jiang Qing was deep in his own world when he suddenly gave a start, startling Lin Xun as well.

"What was that?"

"Nothing. A message came in." The phone had kept vibrating. He quickly took it out, having thought for a moment it was something important. Turned out it was Lin Xun's fan group blowing up.

He was about to put it away when he caught a glimpse of his own name in the chat log.

He sneaked a sidelong glance, put on a front. "What are you looking at?"

Lin Xun obediently turned back, withdrawing his concern.

Shortly after, the car pulled up in front of Bourdain Hotel. Lin Xun got out, bent down, and said to Jiang Qing through the open door, "Thanks for the ride. I'll take you all out to dinner sometime."

"Sure," Shu Tong said warmly. Noticing Jiang Qing had his head down looking at his phone, she reached over and pinched his thigh none too gently. "Have some manners."

"Hss —" Jiang Qing rubbed his leg and said to Lin Xun, "Fine. We'll be having fresh Australian lobster flown in live."

Lin Xun pretended not to hear. "What? Papaya with snow fungus soup?"

Jiang Qing's volume shot up. "Goodbye!"

Lin Xun stood there in the drifting exhaust fumes and laughed until he couldn't stop.

chapters.title: The Fan Group
chapters.content:
Shu Tong pressed a hand to her forehead in resignation. "Could you at least be a little polite?"

Jiang Qing listened to her nagging with one ear while turning his attention back to his phone. His messages had already been buried under a flood of new ones, but his name still surfaced from time to time.

"Pipe down, she's one of us!"

"What do you people who said Jiang Qing was decent mean by that? Have you already forgotten how he looked down on President Lin?"

"Exactly. One trip to the recording and you've already switched sides?"

"This is a fan group for President Lin. If you want to climb the wall, please leave of your own accord."

So the fans who had attended the recording in person were praising him in the group, and now the others thought they were traitors.

Then a girl with a lavender hairclip as her avatar spoke up: "I'm not trying to climb the wall! I'll love President Lin for the rest of my life! But during the recording, Jiang Qing really did perform well, and he even said nice things about President Lin!"

"That's just for the show. Don't forget what he said about President Lin in private. I can't swallow that. Jiang Qing, biss!"

"Xun-ge debuted and got called out by Jiang Qing by name. He got mocked by so many people, and even now there are still people calling him stone-faced. No wonder the sisters upstairs are upset."

Hairclip Girl: "But Jiang Qing already clarified that in an earlier interview. It was just someone deliberately recording him out of context. And this time, Jiang Qing was genuinely attentive in guiding Xun-ge."

"Please. President Lin is already so smart, with such a high IQ, he picks up on everything quickly. How does any of that count as Jiang Qing's doing?"

"Sisters, stop fighting. I was at the recording too. Jiang Qing was actually pretty entertaining, and he even heaped a ton of flattery on Xun-ge. I've saved all the quotes, I think the Lavenders could use them. I'll post them in a bit."

"We won't use them! Don't post them!"

Moderator: "Everyone stop arguing. Read the announcement. This group prohibits mentioning anyone other than President Lin, or you'll get the boot."

Hairclip Girl: "I'm sorry, I shouldn't have brought it up. I'll accept being kicked out without a word of complaint."

Seeing how sincere she was, the others said no more, exchanged a few words with each other, and went back to being good sisters.

Jiang Qing couldn't help himself. He sent the hairclip girl a friend request, and the moment he did, she accepted.

Girl Selling Matches: [I kind of like Jiang Qing too...]

Hairclip Girl: [Crying] [Crying]

Hairclip Girl: Sis, you have to watch "I Am an Actor"! They really do get along well, laughing and talking the whole time. Jiang Qing even wiped Xun-ge's tears! [Starry eyes]

Jiang Qing was startled. This hairclip girl couldn't actually be a staff member, could she? The audience wouldn't have been able to see what went on backstage during rehearsals, let alone something like wiping tears...

He stared at the hairclip avatar for a moment, feeling like he recognized it. He tapped to open the full image.

Case solved. It was the host, Du Yuening!

Du Yuening immediately sent another message: Actually... I've been secretly shipping the two of them as a CP. /covers face

Jiang Qing was so startled his hand jerked, and his phone clattered onto the seat.

He scrambled to pick it up and replied without thinking: Absolutely not!!!!!

Du Yuening: I know, I'm just keeping it to myself! I definitely won't let anyone else know, and sis, don't expose me in the group either!

The car came to a stop. Sang Yi and Shu Tong got out, waited a moment, then noticed Jiang Qing hadn't moved.

Shu Tong opened his door. "What are you dawdling about?"

Jiang Qing got out of the car feebly, leaned against it, and rubbed the bridge of his nose, a thousand feelings stirring in his chest.

He wasn't afraid of a fujoshi shipping a CP. What he was afraid of was someone shipping him with his rival.

Five days later, the second recording of "I Am an Actor" took place.

He was already familiar with the process, and the staff's attitude toward him had improved considerably since the last time. The backstage atmosphere was good. He arrived first, had Shu Tong order some afternoon tea for the crew, then went to the neighboring mentor's lounge to chat with the other two teachers.

The two teachers weren't particularly concerned about his reputation with the general public. Deep down, they were even on Jiang Qing's side. But being public figures, they couldn't go around criticizing others without restraint.

Of course, there were veteran actors in the industry who did criticize younger idols, but those people had the seniority for it.

So in the eyes of their generation of performers, Jiang Qing was truly a young tiger who had no fear of running headfirst into a wall.

Before long, the three of them moved over to the makeup room.

Su Hongru said with a laugh, "With a face as rough as mine, and I still have to put on makeup."

"I think you might be mistaken about yourself. You used to be a housewife-killer back in the day, and now that old-school charm is cycling back around. You've become a young women's killer." Jiang Qing smiled.

"What? I can still be a young women's killer?"

"Of course you can. There are plenty of young girls online who love your dramas. These days, the uncle type is exactly what they're into."

"Is that so? Then I can still give it another shot! Ha ha ha ha!" Su Hongru laughed so hard his cheeks shook, and the makeup artist had to gently remind him to keep still.

Jiang Qing pressed his lips together, holding back a smile.

The contestants this time around were all genuine talents, yet lacking in exposure and resources, and had never managed to break through to fame.

The recording was a delight, and Jiang Qing's flattery was particularly fragrant.

"Your deeply felt performances embody the very essence of what it means to be an actor. It's as though you were born for these roles!"

"From the lines to every movement and expression, there is nothing to fault. You have perfectly recreated the magic of this piece!"

"I saw one of your works a while ago, and the presence you radiated left a deep impression on me from the very first moment! I'm picking you!"

The audience was a new batch, unaware of what had happened in the first episode. So when Jiang Qing opened his mouth, most of them went into a state of shock that only deepened as he went on, until some of them genuinely wondered if they had wandered into the wrong show.

Was this really the arrogant Jiang Qing?

What was going on with all this lavish praise?

Was it written into the script? But even the director seemed to be genuinely surprised by him.

After the recording ended, Jiang Qing ran into Du Yuening in the hallway on his way backstage.

She was standing about a meter away, restraining herself with visible effort as she waved at him excitedly, a faint green gleam dancing in her eyes.

In the past, he might have assumed she was admiring his looks. But now it was obvious to him that she was looking right through him, perceiving a different Jiang Qing and a different Lin Xun on some plane beyond, and doing all sorts of questionable things with them in her head.

Terrifying.

After exchanging greetings, they went their separate ways. He looked down at his phone to cut through the awkwardness and found a notification from Alipay.

Lin Xun: Are you with Ruihua Entertainment? [Smile]

Jiang Qing's fingers paused. He typed back quickly: What about it?

Then he switched screens and, with gleeful malice, opened Lin Xun's Ant Forest and drained his energy completely clean.

Honestly, he'd love to see what Du Yuening would think if she knew the actual state of their relationship. Who in their right mind would ship this pair as a CP?

Hmph.

chapters.title: A Company Visit
chapters.content:
By the time he got home it was late again. The next day was the official air date for the first episode.

He woke up early, only to realize it aired that evening. Unable to fall back asleep, he headed to the gym for a while.

In the afternoon, Shu Tong called and had him come into the company.

"Did you get on Wang Ming's bad side?" Shu Tong asked.

Jiang Qing thought it over. "Who knows. I only met him once and he'd already cast me as his enemy off the bat. Something's wrong with that guy. What happened?"

"He lost the part with Director Yu, so he's been focusing on preparing for his xianxia drama. When he heard you were going to play the villain, he put a word in with the director's side, and they're now considering replacing you."

Jiang Qing's expression brightened. "Great news. I was just trying to figure out how to get out of that project. He's done me a real favor."

"I'm warning you," Shu Tong said helplessly. "The people in your own company are this hostile toward you."

"We won't be in the same company for long. And besides, not everyone dislikes me."

"Name one person in this company who actually likes you."

"It's not just my imagination, I think Gao Yuanqiao is rather fond of me." Jiang Qing sprawled shamelessly across the sofa. "I've assessed the situation. The way he looks at me is different from how other people do."

Shu Tong was slightly taken aback and immediately on guard. "What kind of look?"

"Admiration! He must have glimpsed the artistic soul within my flawless face. Not everyone can manage that."

"Most people also don't have his level of... naivety."

"..." Jiang Qing decided not to discuss the soul with these ordinary mortals. "Hey, Tong-jie. Who do you think his backer is? Just from the way he looks at people, I really can't picture him currying favor with a sugar daddy."

"Some things are better left at surface level. No need to dig too deep." Shu Tong didn't want to say too much. They were only here for half a year anyway, no point wasting too much time on other people's affairs.

Footsteps echoed in the hallway outside, and from the familiar sound of high heels, Shu Tong already knew which old fox it was. She pursed her lips. "Zhang Lingquan must be over the moon today. Her tail's practically poking the sky."

"What's going on?"

"She brought Lin Xun over for a company tour. Apparently she's been in contact with him all along, and he finally agreed to come take a look today."

"..." Jiang Qing bolted upright, eyes wide. "Who?"

"Lin Xun. Zhang Lingquan has actually been reaching out to him this whole time. He agreed to come visit today."

"...Let me see." He got up and opened the door, coming face to face with the group in the hallway at just that moment.

Zhang Lingquan and a junior assistant flanked Lin Xun on either side, enthusiastically introducing the company's facilities and departments.

The Lin Xun in the middle was glancing around and occasionally nodding along, when the opening of a door made him stop in his tracks.

Zhang Lingquan glanced over and smiled a little more deeply than necessary. "Oh, it's Jiang Qing and Tong-jie. Are you here for a schedule today?"

Shu Tong maintained her silence.

Jiang Qing replied, "Came to watch your show."

Shu Tong occasionally appreciated how sharp Jiang Qing's tongue could be.

Zhang Lingquan's expression stiffened for a moment before she plastered on another smile. "What show? I'm just giving someone a tour. If he actually signs with us, that would be something worth watching, wouldn't it, Lin Xun?"

All eyes turned to Lin Xun.

Lin Xun, however, was looking directly at Jiang Qing. He tilted his head with a small smile. "Have you eaten?"

Zhang Lingquan: ???

Since when were they this familiar?!

Jiang Qing's face was expressionless. "I have."

"What a coincidence, so have I." Lin Xun paused, then extended an invitation: "Buy me dinner tonight?"

"Why would I..."

"I will be sure to repay you adequately~" Lin Xun murmured the line from the email.

Jiang Qing: "Got it!"

He stepped back into the room and shut the door behind him with a bang, startling Zhang Lingquan and the assistant.

Zhang Lingquan patted her chest. "Lin Xun, are you close with Jiang Qing?"

"Not particularly."

Good. Zhang Lingquan exhaled with relief, then slipped in a comment without making it obvious: "Jiang Qing is a decent person, just terribly rude. Look at his attitude just now. What kind of way is that to treat a guest?"

Lin Xun listened half-heartedly, then cut her off: "Shall we continue?" The sooner this was over, the sooner they could go to dinner.

An hour later, Lin Xun had a clear enough picture in his head. He said his goodbyes to them with a polite smile, then headed to the nearby Ruien Investment.

The moment he walked into Yang Meng's office, he opened the spare computer and said, "I've finished touring all the companies. Let me organize my thoughts first."

Yang Meng, being perceptive, knew better than to disturb him.

Outside, the sun was sinking. Yang Meng's throat was dry, so he got up to pour some water, and as he passed behind Lin Xun, he caught a glimpse of the screen from the corner of his eye. "If I'm seeing this correctly," he said, "you're chatting with someone on Alipay?"

Lin Xun turned to look at him. "Yes. Is there a problem?"

"Possibly a brain problem." Yang Meng said bluntly. "Using email every day is already one thing, but isn't WeChat or QQ right there?"

"I understand the logic, but the person won't add me on WeChat." Lin Xun let out an almost imperceptible sigh.

Yang Meng stopped walking and dropped into the seat beside him, eyes lighting up with excitement. "Who is it? Someone actually won't add you on WeChat? You have to introduce me to this girl!"

Back when they were studying abroad, he had been something of a campus figure himself. But then Lin Xun, who was a year below him, enrolled, and he was instantly eclipsed.

And the most ridiculous part was that he had been completely won over by the guy himself.

Yet now there was someone out there who didn't put Lin Xun first? If it was a woman, he was absolutely going to make his move.

Lin Xun smiled faintly. "Jiang Qing."

The corner of Yang Meng's mouth twitched. "Well, that's not surprising at all. He probably wouldn't bother adding the Jade Emperor himself."

Lin Xun raised an eyebrow, a suggestive smile spreading slowly across his eyes. "When you put it like that, I'm rather tempted to try the Jade Emperor now."

That expression. Yang Meng silently lit three sticks of incense in his head for Jiang Qing.

They'd known each other for nearly ten years, and he knew this person's nature inside out.

Lin Xun had never had something he couldn't do, only things he didn't care to.

At the time, when Lin Xun had come back to see friends and family, Yang Meng had talked him into trying an acting role with great effort. His only intention had been to protect his investment, but who could have predicted it would take off like that?

Whenever Lin Xun wore that quietly confident expression, the outcome usually followed his expectations.

"So how are you planning to get to him?" Yang Meng was intensely curious and nosy.

Lin Xun blinked. "Isn't it just a matter of getting his WeChat?"

"Oh. My mistake."

"Tsk." Lin Xun shot him a disdainful look, his attention quickly pulled back to his phone. The chat window was still open, and Jiang Qing had finally replied.

Lin Xun: Off work? What are you planning to treat me to?

Jiang Qing's reply: "Papaya stewed snow jelly."

Lin Xun stretched, uncrossed his long legs, stood up and straightened his clothes, then put on his sunglasses.

Yang Meng: "Are you headed out on a date or to pick a fight?"

"I'm not coming back tonight." Lin Xun walked straight toward the door.

Yang Meng: "..." Something about that sentence sounded very wrong no matter how he parsed it.

As a good friend, he felt obligated to offer a reminder, so he called out to the retreating figure: "Remember to take precautions!"

Lin Xun's step faltered, and he nearly performed an accidental front somersault on the spot.

chapters.title: Dinner
chapters.content:
Jiang Qing chose a restaurant that was extremely expensive. Truly and genuinely eye-wateringly expensive, so expensive it almost made him want to cry.

One meal here would cost him several new outfits of the latest season.

Still, if he treated Lin Xun to this dinner, he could consider the favor he owed him properly repaid.

He had barely sat down when Lin Xun arrived and settled into the seat across from him with unhurried ease.

Jiang Qing was still looking over the menu and slid it across the table. "Order whatever you like. You can even pick the expensive things..."

"Sure." Lin Xun smiled and took it.

Jiang Qing had only meant it as a polite thing to say. He hadn't expected Lin Xun to actually take him at his word, but everything the man chose was expensive.

Once they'd ordered, Jiang Qing found himself at a loss for words.

The two of them stared at each other until Jiang Qing's eyes were nearly crossing. He rubbed his face and asked, "Are you signing with our company?"

"No."

"Then what? You spent over an hour touring the place just to check it off a list?"

Lin Xun nodded unexpectedly. "Exactly. Just checking it off."

Jiang Qing: "..." Whatever. Just whatever.

He could only wonder what expression Zhang Lingquan would make when she found out he'd said no.

Lin Xun watched him at leisure. "How did you know I was there for over an hour?"

Jiang Qing's eyes darted away. There was absolutely no way he was going to admit that he'd been paying close attention the whole time.

"I guessed. Besides, Zhang Lingquan made such a production of it that the whole company was watching."

"Is that so. I thought you might have been sneaking peeks at me." A flicker of amusement crossed Lin Xun's eyes.

"Not, not possible." Jiang Qing lowered his head and pretended to scroll through his phone. "Oh right, the show airs tonight."

Lin Xun raised an eyebrow. "Are you looking forward to it?"

"Of course, it's my comeback..." The word "comeback" didn't quite make it out of his mouth, and he caught himself in time. Why was he being so upfront about this?

He snapped his mouth shut and said, a little awkwardly, "I was just wondering why the lobster I ordered that's supposed to turn things around hasn't arrived yet."

Lin Xun's eyelashes gave a faint flutter, and he smiled wider.

Jiang Qing found himself looking at him a beat longer than intended. Those features were enough to make anyone envious. He asked with genuine curiosity, "What's your background? What mix are you?"

Lin Xun blinked, his gaze flickering. He propped his chin on one hand and turned the question back. "How did you know?"

His family background had been deliberately suppressed. There was no way to find it on any website at this point. His irises were a deep brown that wasn't obvious unless you looked carefully, and not particularly unusual even then.

Fans had spent a good while assuming he was either from a remote region of the country or wearing colored contacts.

"Did you investigate me?" he pressed.

Jiang Qing pressed his lips together.

Damn, he'd let it slip.

Before his rebirth, someone online had leaked that the top star Lin Xun carried a quarter of mixed heritage, and Lin Xun hadn't denied it. But at this point in time, Lin Xun was still keeping it under wraps.

Time to deploy his true skills as a Best Actor.

He arranged his expression into theatrical surprise, brought both hands up to his chest as if barely containing his disbelief, and let his eyes light up with wonder. "No way! You're really mixed? I knew it! With eyes this beautiful and distinctive and unforgettable, you just have the look of someone with mixed heritage!"

Lin Xun's expression eased, and he thought to himself that he hadn't even had a drop of alcohol yet, so why was his head a little fuzzy.

Jiang Qing quietly let out a breath of relief, and quietly noticed something.

Lin Xun seemed to... enjoy being praised.

He decided to test the theory over dinner.

Once the food arrived, Lin Xun peeled shrimp with unhurried composure. Even faced with a table of delicacies, he showed no particular eagerness.

Odd. Most people, confronted with food of this caliber, would practically be drooling like an eager puppy.

After thinking it over, there was really only one explanation.

Jiang Qing peeled his own shrimp and said casually, "Does Yang Meng treat you well?"

Lin Xun's hand paused. He looked up. "Pretty well. Why?"

"Ah."

Lin Xun was entirely baffled, feeling as though his reputed 160 IQ was consistently no match for this person.

"What made you bring him up?"

"Curious, that's all." Jiang Qing flashed a grin, goofy and charming all at once.

Lin Xun smiled and returned to peeling. "Do you want to meet him?"

If he wanted to, Lin Xun could make an introduction. Plenty of people in the industry were eager to get in with Yang Meng.

"No, no. I don't like him." Jiang Qing shook his head repeatedly.

Lin Xun's hands stilled again. He stared at Jiang Qing in disbelief, and it took him a moment to say: "Good. I appreciate that."

A person who also disliked Yang Meng. This was a true kindred spirit.

Of course, hearing those words, Jiang Qing took them in an entirely different way.

This was obviously Lin Xun afraid that he'd go and compete for the backer's attention.

Understandable, really. He was so exceptional that of course the other party would feel some sense of threat.

He glanced at Lin Xun, then decided to test the waters. "You're quite good at that. Looking more closely, your hands are beautiful too, long and slender and fair. Quite the treat for hand enthusiasts. Just watching your hands like this, it's honestly rather, rather... quite appetizing."

A few seconds of silence fell over the table.

Neither side moved.

Then, after a moment, Lin Xun did.

Jiang Qing watched as Lin Xun placed the peeled shrimp into a clean bowl, eyes fixed on him without moving.

Had he pushed too hard? Had the flattery backfired?

Just as he was preparing to salvage the situation, the lazy susan on the table began to turn. Slowly, that bowl drifted to a stop in front of him, filled with tender, fragrant shrimp.

Jiang Qing: ?

Lin Xun said: "Go ahead." That sweet mouth of yours.

"I won't say no to that." Fresh shrimp, ready to eat, there for the taking. He ate, and then wanted more.

So he kept eating and kept talking, and by the end, a good half of the shrimp had made its way into his stomach.

Lin Xun kept up an attentive service, not seeming to tire of it at all, glancing at Jiang Qing every so often. Watching him eat with the diligence of a little hamster while his honey-dipped mouth never quite stopped running, Lin Xun found his mood steadily improving, his appetite growing, and something warm and rare spreading through him that felt like a very particular kind of fortune.

Jiang Qing: "Eat something too. Don't just pay attention to me."

"Alright." Lin Xun ate with quiet contentment, thinking to himself that this person was rather considerate.

In reality, Jiang Qing was simply getting full.

After dinner, Jiang Qing leaned back in his chair with deep satisfaction and let out a long sigh.

That had been wonderful. He hadn't had a proper meal in nearly half a month, and tonight he had finally made up for lost time.

"Thank you for dinner." Lin Xun said.

"Don't mention it. And this makes us even!"

A full stomach really did improve one's mood.

"Sounds fair."

The two of them walked out to the parking lot side by side. Jiang Qing checked the time and mentioned offhandedly, "The show's about to start."

Lin Xun asked, "Where do you live? I'll drive you home."

"Sure." Jiang Qing took the offer without hesitation.

Sang Yi had picked him up when he came to the company, but with this meal having come up unexpectedly, he'd already sent her home with the car.

After that accident, he'd developed a bit of a reluctance to drive. He'd planned to walk home, but it would take half an hour and he'd miss the broadcast.

Once they were in the car, Lin Xun had barely started the engine before he noticed Jiang Qing clutching his seatbelt with both hands like a primary school student on a field trip, staring straight ahead with intense concentration.

Anyone who didn't know better would think they were running some kind of traffic safety drill.

Lin Xun asked, "What's wrong?"

"Drive safely. Red means stop, green means go, yellow means wait. No cutting people off, no crossing the line, no speeding..." Jiang Qing rattled on.

"Understood. Where are we going?" Lin Xun was patient.

"Yishui Bay Residential Complex."

Lin Xun's hand paused, then he quickly searched the address and started the car.

The pace was smooth. Jiang Qing relaxed before long and let his eyes wander. The interior was clean and new, and the air carried a faint woody scent.

His gaze drifted from the air freshener to the hands on the steering wheel. Sleeves rolled to the elbows, evenly toned, slender, and fair. They turned the wheel with ease. Lin Xun's head tilted slightly toward the side mirror, jawline defined, throat moving as he swallowed, and from this angle that looked particularly striking.

...No wonder people said men look especially good when they're behind the wheel.

Noted for future reference. He'd have to make that same effortless show of cool one day.

When they arrived, Jiang Qing got out, said thank you, and walked ahead.

Lin Xun sat in the car watching his retreating figure. The headlights stretched his shadow long before him, and the night breeze stirred the hair near his ear...

Then suddenly, Jiang Qing turned around, pointed a finger pointedly in his direction, and gave him a wave.

Lin Xun's lips slowly curved upward. He put on the hazard lights in response.

Then, for some reason, something came to mind. He sent Yang Meng a message.

"The properties you mentioned this afternoon, was one of them in Yishui Bay?"

chapters.title: The Broadcast
chapters.content:
Jiang Qing opened the refrigerator. It was nothing but drinks and alcohol. He took out a bottle of unsweetened soda, settled onto the sofa to wait for the broadcast, and pulled out his phone to see what people were saying online.

The show's official account had posted a "Stay tuned" teaser on Weibo. The comments were sparse, not even close to the amount of attention Wang Mingzhi's new haircut was getting on the trending list.

The show was airing simultaneously on satellite TV and streaming. He took out his tablet, propped it on the coffee table, and opened the video platform.

The timing was perfect. The show began.

It opened with clips from classic films and dramas, then the camera swept across the stage and settled on the host. The host's voice rang out, introducing the show.

The barrage of comments appeared alongside it.

[First!]

[The set looks decent. Let's see how the show goes.]

[Du Yuening is so pretty! She has such presence, love it!]

After Du Yuening finished reading out all the sponsors, she officially introduced the three mentors.

Jiang Qing emerged from backstage in a well-cut suit that traced a perfect silhouette, the studio lights behind him like a halo. He stopped center stage, presence commanding, and smiled warmly at the audience.

[He's here he's here he's here]

[A round of applause for the entertainment industry's #1 menace!]

[This look? I'm obsessed.]

[He's so ugly. Can I have a pair of eyes that have never seen him?]

[You in front calling him ugly, let's see you look better then.]

[Honestly, Jiang Qing's looks do deliver.]

[Ahhhh Teacher Wen and Su Hongru are here!!!]

[Wait, they're going straight into the competition? No interviews or discussion segments?!]

[That's a good thing! Cut straight to it, less filler, more substance. Good show!]

The footage cut to the two contestants' rehearsals from the day before, which was new information even for Jiang Qing. He watched with genuine interest.

The young fresh-faced idol arrived at the practice room first, followed by Gao Yuanqiao. The editing didn't linger on small talk, moving quickly to their rehearsal.

Gao Yuanqiao was earnest. Despite having less name recognition and fewer fans than the idol, he wasn't intimidated, and he spoke up whenever he had ideas. The idol's expression, correspondingly, wasn't particularly pleasant.

The moment the camera shifted to the idol, Jiang Qing lost interest and started glancing at the comments.

[Where did this newcomer come from? Bullying my brother like that? Overriding his lines to steal scenes, seriously?]

[I actually think Gao Yuanqiao's ideas are pretty good.]

[Gao Yuanqiao is kind of cute. Can he actually pull off that creepy character?]

[Wait wait wait, look at what I just found! Look at Gao Yuanqiao's blazer!]

[I saw it too! The brooch! It's a red panda!!!]

[Jiang Qing is wearing the same one right now!]

[What is this incredible coincidence? Are they connected somehow?!]

[Sharp-tongued mentor x the pure newbie actor? I'm already shipping it!]

What the...

Jiang Qing was baffled.

Were these viewers watching through a microscope?

He looked more carefully. Gao Yuanqiao was indeed wearing a matching brooch.

Gao Yuanqiao must have borrowed it one day, and then it had made its way back to him the next.

The identical taste, and this maddening coincidence...

Just as he was at a loss, a notification popped up on the tablet. An Alipay message.

Lin Xun: The brooch?

Jiang Qing saw it and mentally rolled his eyes up to the ceiling.

The next second, another message appeared.

Lin Xun: Is it this kind? [Red panda brooch image]

Jiang Qing: !!! Where did you get that?

Lin Xun: A little sister gave it to me. She said if I held onto this brooch, I would meet my destined person.

Jiang Qing: ...

Jiang Qing: I can't believe I fell for that.

Lin Xun watched the string of "angry," "cleaver," and "pile of dung" emojis Jiang Qing sent back to back, and dissolved into honking laughter alone in his enormous living room.

He wasn't the one who had lied. That honor belonged to someone else.

Half a year ago when he'd returned to the country, his younger cousin had talked him out of a limited-edition watch and a pile of gifts in exchange for a brooch she had hyped up as though it were the most extraordinary thing on earth.

Meanwhile, the show continued. Gao Yuanqiao and the idol were already onstage. He hadn't been out front during the recording, so he'd had no time to watch the other two groups.

The idol looked sharp in the police uniform, and the comment section was flooded with devoted fans going wild. Gao Yuanqiao, by contrast, looked a little rumpled, with a face darkened for the role and considerably fewer supporters.

But a few minutes in, the general audience's impression began to shift.

[Wait, this newcomer is actually good. Has he been in anything before?]

[The cop is clearly getting overshadowed. No comparison, no heartbreak, as they say.]

[His eyes are so expressive! I got chills!]

This was right at the reversal scene where Gao Yuanqiao pressed a gun to the idol's side. Lin Xun, watching that comment go by, thought: you haven't seen eyes with real presence yet.

Back in that restroom, with nothing around them at all, one simulated gun gesture from Jiang Qing had been enough to make his blood run cold.

The camera cut to the mentors' panel. Teacher Wen was smiling, Su Hongru was serene, Jiang Qing looked cold.

[Jiang Qing's expression is scary. I thought they did well?]

[Protect my brother!]

[Jiang Qing's profile is kind of good-looking.]

Lin Xun gave that last comment a like.

The scene ended, and the two contestants spoke. Gao Yuanqiao kept saying things like "same" and "me too," getting the audience laughing out loud.

[Lmaooo where did this little sweetie come from?]

[Hahaha, look, Jiang Qing's face finally changed! That look of profound disappointment!]

[I feel like Jiang Qing has been watching this newcomer this whole time!]

[OMG the person who said sharp-tongued mentor x newbie actor earlier, WAIT FOR ME!]

[Same! Me too!]

Finally it was time for the mentors' assessments, and Lin Xun paid closer attention.

[Teacher Wen and Su Hongru are so good at this. The one in the back should take notes.]

[Jiang Qing's critiques are actually pretty accurate each time. These two performers are underwhelming. Let me light two candles for them in advance.]

[Brace yourselves!]

Just as everyone was mentally mourning for the contestants, words descended on them like thunderclaps, shattering them and sending their spirits flying. The comment section was wall-to-wall question marks for a solid half minute.

[A dog's mouth actually produced a rainbow? It compliments now???]

[Am I deaf? Am I blind? Was that Jiang Qing? Did someone do a soul swap?]

[What?! What is happening? What is Jiang Qing doing?]

[Okay but look at the entire room's reaction. Not a single person escaped his lavish praise! Ha!]

[Jiang Qing officially certified! My brother really is handsome!]

[Holy, why is he singing now lmaooo]

[Jiang Qing who reads poems aloud. You have successfully caught my attention!]

[I laughed with the strength it took Pangu to split heaven and earth. I can't find my head!]

[Help, there's a sound in my brain. You're really, truly... please stop!]

...

It wasn't until the second pair of contestants took the stage that the comment section gradually stopped revisiting the first group. The second performance was polished and impressive, and quite a few viewers began to appreciate what the show was trying to do: to unearth more performers like these, to let talented actors take the stage and show the world what real craft looks like.

The third group's performance was coming up soon.

[Lin Xun's about to come on, right? Wasn't it Jiang Qing who called his acting "desk interview acting" a while back? What "desk interview acting"?]

[Comment shields up.]

Lin Xun suddenly messaged Jiang Qing: Actually, I was wearing the brooch that day too.

Jiang Qing: ?

Jiang Qing: shit

Lin Xun: Watch your language.

Jiang Qing: shift!

Lin Xun burst into another round of honking laughter.

chapters.title: An Enthusiastic Response
chapters.content:
Lin Xun kneaded his cheeks, which were beginning to ache from grinning. Lucky no one was around. If his friends and family saw him like this, he'd never hear the end of it.

On the day he went to the television station, Yang Meng had sent over a professional stylist. The stylist decided to go for an approachable image for Lin Xun, and at first glance had zeroed in on the brooch he'd left sitting casually on the table...

[Wait, did the production team wholesale these brooches?!]

[HAHAHAHA here it comes, here it comes, here comes our handsome guy with his brooch!]

[This doesn't look like a sponsor either. Where did all three red pandas come from?]

[The speed of Chinese online shopping. I bow down. The same panda brooch is already listed for sale.]

[Sisters! Drop the link!]

The rehearsal footage was meant to showcase two attractive people, but everyone was too busy talking about the panda brooch on Lin Xun's jacket.

Xu Jiacheng, who was also watching, could never have imagined that a panda brooch was going to steal her spotlight. In her fury, she went on an online shopping site and ordered ninety-nine of the same brooch.

The footage moved to their full performance. Xu Jiacheng watched herself and was satisfied with what she saw. Her fans were lavishing her with praise in a steady stream. She made a concerted effort to ignore the even greater number of comments screaming for Lin Xun, and managed to stay in a decent mood.

Of course she also had to admit that she herself had been taken aback by his performance during the show.

They were both supposed to be pretty faces, so why had he suddenly displayed acting ability he had no business having?

Xu Jiacheng felt profoundly betrayed, especially since he had been perfectly average during rehearsal, and then had somehow just clicked on, eclipsing her entirely.

She was furious.

So when her management team asked if she wanted to leverage this and start a CP narrative with Lin Xun, she flatly refused.

[This is bold! Lin Xun actually dares to perform the role that was based on Jiang Qing in front of the man himself? Just for the nerve alone I'm already on my knees!]

[Ahhhhh Lin Xun is so handsome! He looks good no matter what he plays! This shy, adorable big boy, who could possibly not love him!]

[President Lin, kill me! This role was made for him!]

[I have to say, Lin Xun did really well. I'm going to go watch his last project.]

[The part's here, I literally cried my eyes out when I first saw it!]

[Honestly, Jiang Qing's manners could use some work, but the movie itself was genuinely good.]

[Ahhh Lin Xun's crying scene is incredible! Three seconds to tears! Wuwuwuwu]

[Haven't seen this film. Can someone spoil it? Does the female lead survive?]

[It's a happy ending, don't worry! I'm going back for my third rewatch right now! This movie is brilliant!]

[This film shot on location for half a year. Looking at it this way, Director Yu really was more meticulous and deliberate back then. His commercial films in recent years haven't won any major awards. What Jiang Qing said before wasn't entirely wrong.]

[Box office results don't all come down to the director. Jiang Qing can't be washed clean of this one.]

[Stop fighting! Can we just watch the show without dragging in personal grudges? Setting aside all biases, I think Lin Xun's performance was genuinely solid. Not quite at Jiang Qing's level yet, but getting there.]

[Wait! The only mentor who hasn't chosen anyone is down to one now. If Lin Xun wins... oh, this is exciting!]

It had to be said, some viewers had already learned how the show worked. The more interesting the matchup, the more likely it was that the show would put them together.

From the very beginning, Lin Xun and Jiang Qing had been packaged and linked together, and now Lin Xun was performing in the role that was inspired by Jiang Qing. Even thinking about the outcome was obvious, anyone could guess Lin Xun would come out on top.

But they had guessed the ending without guessing how spectacular it would be.

When Jiang Qing recited that poem, the comment section collectively erupted in laughter.

"Before my bed the moonlight gleams, Lin Xun peerless in my dreams. I lift my head to see the moon, my maiden heart pounds to its tune."

The comments blanked out the screen entirely, with those four lines scrolling in neat formation right down the middle.

Jiang Qing caught up on the trending topics, and people were already flooding the hashtags.

After that came the challenge segment against the mentors, and this was the first time Jiang Qing saw how the other two mentors had handled their guidance sessions.

Su Hongru's segment was entertaining. He told Gao Yuanqiao to run a couple of laps to work up a sweat and get into the feeling. He meant for him to jog around the rehearsal room, but the moment Su Hongru turned away to pick up a script, Gao Yuanqiao ran out the door.

[Hahahaha what is this little sweetheart! I'm jumping ship right now!]

[Hahaha he's running so earnestly! Is he going to crash into someone?]

[Okay, who let the psychic in here. They literally just said it and he immediately crashed into someone?]

[WAIT did Lin Xun just... catch Jiang Qing?! Tell me I'm not imagining things!]

[Well, the three pandas are reunited.]

[This is aesthetically stunning...]

[Can we please not force ships onto people? Let Jiang Qing be his gorgeous self in peace without dragging others in!]

[Can we please get to Jiang Qing's group's footage already!]

Because of Gao Yuanqiao's accidental interruption, Jiang Qing and Lin Xun had appeared on camera earlier than expected, so by the time the show came back to assess Gao Yuanqiao's group, the audience was still focused on waiting for them.

The footage quickly cut to the third group's rehearsal room. First it showed Jiang Qing going to discuss the camera work and scene structure with the director, then back to the rehearsal room.

The rehearsal room footage only lasted a few minutes. Throughout, he kept calling out "Again" and "Once more." Lin Xun, a light sheen of sweat on him, listened carefully to his instructions and direction. With the tedious in-between moments cut out, this pairing actually looked remarkably harmonious and in sync.

The Lavender fans were thoroughly confused.

Their ten thousand prepared lines of condemnation... seemed to have no application?

Why wasn't Jiang Qing playing by the script? Wasn't this supposed to be a PR stunt? Why was he being so genuinely thorough in guiding President Lin?

And why did President Lin seem to be enjoying it, listening so willingly?

Could this all just be a beautiful and heartbreaking misunderstanding?

For a moment they didn't know whether to be glad or troubled.

Just as they were watching with burning anticipation for the actual performance, the footage froze right at the moment Lin Xun had Jiang Qing pinned beneath him, interrogating him about his identity...

[Progress bar warning!]

[I'm going insane! Show me the next episode! Evil editing!]

[Oh my god, I'm so excited for this group's performance! "The World at Its Finest" is one of my favorites! I can't wait for next week!]

The preview for next episode began to play. There was a brief flash of Jiang Qing and Lin Xun in their scene together, with Jiang Qing's voice speaking off screen.

"One vote from you and one from me, and we'll send him all the way through to the finals!"

The audience was left wanting more and flooded Weibo to talk about it. Clips from every performance were cut and shared in endless discussion. Every contestant and mentor's profile was dug up again. The idol's fans went into full celebration mode, while the hidden gems in the lineup were picked out and highlighted by general viewers.

All three mentors saw a considerable boost in their own buzz, and the view count on "No Borders" doubled. On top of that, Jiang Qing earned himself a solo trending spot.

#JiangQingRainbowPraise#

Even viewers who had no context were intrigued by the title alone and clicked in to see what it was about.

Oh. Oh wow.

Now that was a piece of gossip worth savoring.

One big-name blogger edited all of Jiang Qing's flattery together and called it "Essential Lines for Every Fandom Girl," and it was being reposted nonstop across the community.

Jiang Qing's fans were momentarily at a loss. It was the first time their idol had gone viral for heaping praise on other people.

Beyond that, #TheThreePandaBrothers# had sprung into existence, giving rise to three separate ships.

Jiang Qing x Gao Yuanqiao.

Lin Xun x Jiang Qing.

Lin Xun x Jiang Qing x Gao Yuanqiao.

Jiang Qing: "."

What was this. Was he some kind of all-purpose ingredient? There was even a trio pairing now?

These netizens were truly something else.

Shu Tong said she would deal with suppressing the cult-like fandom activity, and he was satisfied with that. He checked the ratings and buzz, mood good enough to start getting ready for bed.

The current numbers confirmed the show was a hit. With this leverage in hand, he could move on to seriously negotiating with the company tomorrow.

A while later, he opened his eyes, staring into the dark, a glint of clarity moving through his gaze. He'd just remembered something important he hadn't done yet.

Late at night, when no one was around, it was the perfect time for energy theft.

Sorry about this, Panda Big Brother.

chapters.title: The Seeker Fan Club
chapters.content:
Shu Tong was up early dealing with the online situation. When Jiang Qing came in, she said, "Gao Yuanqiao posted on Weibo. He confirmed the panda brooch was borrowed from the wardrobe department."

"Do I need to post anything?"

"No. The official statement's already out. Gao Yuanqiao's team has been dismantling the CP narratives since last night, and Lin Xun's side seems to have done something as well. All three sides moved together, and the CP fans have retreated back to their own corners."

"Good."

He had no interest in stoking a CP narrative. While it was an effective way to generate exposure for new faces, it wasn't the right approach for someone like him who had spent years building a presence on the big screen. It would damage his screen image, and cleaning up the fanbase afterward would be a tremendous headache. No point wading into that.

The other two were even easier to read. Both had backers to think about.

He moved on to the real business. "Has Manager Chen arrived?"

"He's still in a meeting. I scheduled you in for ten o'clock."

"Alright."

At ten o'clock, Manager Chen was still seated in the conference room. He looked up as the two of them walked in. "Sit."

Jiang Qing sat across from him. He read the distance and wariness in the man's eyes and dispensed with pleasantries. "Manager Chen, you watched the variety show last night."

"I did. The ratings were excellent. You did well."

Gao Yuanqiao's Weibo following had jumped by more than three million overnight. Jiang Qing's had grown by over a million. The higher-ups were pleased, which only confirmed how sound their decision had been.

"I held up my end of the deal. Gao Yuanqiao is now in the semifinals... I don't need to keep managing him after this, do I?"

"That won't do. The show has built a solid reputation. More wins would be good for everyone." Manager Chen was quick to say. "Don't you want a second chance? This is a rare opportunity. Both you and Gao Yuanqiao have a long road ahead of you."

Jiang Qing said, "You saw the show. The other contestants clearly have more experience and skill than Gao Yuanqiao, and I've heard from the director that they'll be bringing in more talented people in later rounds. It would be very difficult to openly favor him."

Manager Chen understood. This was a roundabout way of asking for more.

He issued a warning: "The show could go on without you. We're only one episode in."

Jiang Qing smiled. "Is that so? You're welcome to ask the director whether he'd still be willing to replace me at this point."

Manager Chen choked on that.

Half the buzz around the show had Jiang Qing's name all over it. There was no way they'd let go of such a valuable asset.

Which meant the leverage was currently in Jiang Qing's hands.

Manager Chen swallowed. "What do you want?"

Only then did Jiang Qing allow himself a real smile, though it left Manager Chen feeling distinctly uneasy.

"It's not much..." Jiang Qing said, drawing it out.

Manager Chen quickly ran through every ongoing project in the resources department, bracing himself for whatever outrageous demand was about to come.

"I just want a shampoo endorsement."

Manager Chen's train of thought came to a sudden halt. He coughed several times from the abruptness of it. "What? Shampoo? Which brand?"

Jiang Qing named the domestic brand that had been taken away from him earlier.

Manager Chen's brow furrowed deeply, and for a moment he didn't know what to say. After all that buildup, shampoo was all he wanted?

"Your reasoning?" Manager Chen said. "That brand seems to already be in talks with someone else."

"First, it's an accessible, homegrown label, which will improve his approval among general audiences. Second, it allows for a short-term contract, so it won't interfere with any premium endorsements down the line..." Shu Tong laid out the logic clearly and methodically, and Manager Chen found himself nodding along.

In closing, Shu Tong said, "In short, it's the right fit for an artist like Jiang Qing who urgently needs to improve his image with the wider public."

Jiang Qing smiled and nodded in agreement.

A gleam crossed Manager Chen's eyes. His mind worked quickly, and his tone softened a little. "But this isn't the right fit for you. You're a Best Actor award winner, you can't take an endorsement like this. Let me keep an eye out for something better."

Jiang Qing put on a suitably wistful expression.

"Don't worry," Manager Chen said soothingly. "There'll be a brand that suits you eventually. Oh, and speaking of which, we've been contacted by several new show pitches recently. I'll find you a good variety program to go on!"

Jiang Qing looked up. "Really?"

"Absolutely." Manager Chen was firm.

"Thank you so much, Manager Chen." Jiang Qing smiled brightly, and tossed out a parting blessing as he left: "Happy birthday, Manager Chen."

Manager Chen smiled and waved him off, then reached for his water and paused.

Wait. His birthday was months ago.

He pushed that aside and immediately got on the phone to relay the shampoo endorsement pitch upstairs, repeating Shu Tong's exact reasoning word for word. The response came quickly: give it to Gao Yuanqiao.

He knew it. Good thing he hadn't handed it straight to Jiang Qing.

So the higher-ups were clearly committed to pushing Gao Yuanqiao. That meant the show needed to keep going, and Jiang Qing would need to be thrown a bone.

He went back to the resources department and told them to find a few low-profile variety programs for Jiang Qing.

The moment Jiang Qing walked back into the office, he and Shu Tong exchanged a high five.

Shu Tong felt like she was getting more juvenile by the day, but she was grinning. "Are you sure they'll give that endorsement to Gao Yuanqiao?"

"Whoever they give it to is fine. Either way it'll never end up with me." Jiang Qing dropped onto the sofa without ceremony. The rest of it wasn't his problem. Let them fight over the scraps.

"Oh right, Lin Xun came by the company yesterday," Shu Tong brought it up suddenly. Jiang Qing lazily lifted his eyes, and she said, "Nothing came of it. I honestly can't tell what he was there for."

Jiang Qing rolled onto his side, and added offhandedly: "I went to dinner with him last night."

Shu Tong blinked, then grabbed his arm and flipped him over, eyes bright. "With who? Lin Xun?"

"Yeah. What are you getting so excited about?"

"You actually went to dinner!" she said. "What did you talk about?"

Jiang Qing thought about it for a moment. "A lot of nonsense." Honey-flavored nonsense.

Speaking of which, he picked up his phone and did a loop of Weibo, and found that he'd gained over a million new followers.

And the comments section and super topic board had finally shifted away from an unbroken wall of praise for his acting.

They were now... filled with his compliment quotes?

What was this? His face wasn't worthy of mention?

That was genuinely irritating.

At that moment, a QQ friend reached out to chat.

Jiang Qing looked at the contact he'd saved as "Degenerate Host Fan Who Shouldn't Be Left Unsupervised" and felt a sudden premonition that something was about to go wrong.

Du Yuening: Sweetie, did you see the group messages? They've finally come around to what I was saying! Ha ha ha ha ha!

Jiang Qing raised an eyebrow and went to check in on the Lavender fans.

"Jiang Qing seems like he was genuinely trying to help Lin Xun?"

"+1 (running away with a lid over my head"

"There's apparently a staff member who leaked online that Jiang Qing and Lin Xun's personal relationship is actually pretty good? They apparently had a meal together in the same room."

Rumor. There were four people in that room.

Girl Selling Matches: "Not quite. Jiang Qing's manager and assistant were there too. And Xun-ge was calling him teacher, showing him a lot of respect and admiration."

"This person, I'm starting to wonder if you're actually a fan of ours."

Jiang Qing stayed quiet and watched the situation develop.

Then Du Yuening appeared and dropped an image directly into the group.

A long hallway, overhead light spilling down onto two silhouettes, one in black and one in white. Their posture was intimate, heads turned toward each other, shadows falling behind them, as though they were whispering something private...

Jiang Qing's finger slipped. As expected. The bad feeling had materialized.

"Wait, is Xun-ge the one putting his arm around Jiang Qing?"

"I'm not gonna lie, this picture is... kind of tempting."

"Honestly I thought I could ship any of the three panda pairs, but now I only want this one."

"If Jiang Qing stops being toxic to President Lin, I can accept this!!"

"A sharp-tongued, stunning Best Actor undergoes a change overnight, and it's all for the person he once looked down on. Why the change? Because of love, because of a love long kept caged and restrained!"

The conversation was rapidly deteriorating.

Jiang Qing decided he had to put a stop to this, so he sent the ringleader a private message: "Focus on your real job, don't neglect your actual responsibilities."

Du Yuening: "A word from my sister has awakened me from my dream!"

He had meant it as a reminder that she was, after all, a public figure. But the very next moment she was in the group rallying everyone to create a CP super topic, announcing herself as the moderator.

Truly never forgetting her calling as a "host."

Du Yuening commanded an enthusiastic response. The super topic was built in no time, name already decided: Seeker Fan Club.

Description: We slaughter gods and vanquish Buddhas, and the Seeker Fan Club shall see its ship sail into harbor.

Sail into harbor? He was going to help them sink into the sea.

Jiang Qing was incensed. There was something uniquely terrible about watching a cult organization build itself up right in front of you and being unable to say anything about it.
