"Hold me up properly, or I'll make your life very difficult."

Jiang Qing waited a bit, and then saw the two of them appear at the elevator entrance, with Gao Yuanqiao having been conscripted into the role of sidekick, wearing the expression of someone thoroughly put-upon.

"Yu Minghan, let him go." Jiang Qing said.

Yu Minghan let go, and bounced over to Jiang Qing's side, rubbing his hands together eagerly. "I've got some first-rate gossip! Heh heh heh!"

The group made their way to Lin Xun's apartment. Gao Yuanqiao peered around curiously.

Yu Minghan, entirely at home, launched straight into gossip-sharing mode. "Lao Jiang, listen to this. I was on a variety show yesterday as a guest, and it turned out that Wang Mingzhi is one of the permanent cast members!"

Gao Yuanqiao's smile stopped. His entire body went rigid as he looked at him, maintaining a carefully neutral expression while quietly sitting down beside him.

"That idiot had his acting skills publicly roasted not long ago, and now he's already got this great variety show resource! He used the show to get a bunch of new fans and then played the victim for sympathy." Yu Minghan accepted the drink Jiang Qing tossed over. "Hey, whose apartment is this, yours or Lin Xun's? You seem way too comfortable here. Where is Lao Lin?!"

Lin Xun was in the middle of coordinating with Sang Yi to have her come with groceries, and while he was at it, had Yang Meng come over too.

Since he was cooking, everyone may as well eat together.

Jiang Qing ignored the pointless question and sank contentedly into the sofa, feet up, lord of the manor. "And then?"

"And then I gave him a piece of my mind, and his face looked like he'd swallowed something foul, which absolutely killed me ha ha ha ha! Later I caught another piece of gold gossip. He got a call from some man, and the way he sounded was absolutely groveling! He called the man family, but please, I know exactly what kind of lapdog situation that is, even if I've never been one!"

Yu Minghan cracked himself up and toppled sideways from laughing, until he bumped into a shoulder, and immediately sat upright. "My friend, you're remarkably quiet over there. Playing the invisible man?"

"Yuanqiao, introduce yourself." Jiang Qing said.

"Oh...... hi, I'm Gao Yuanqiao." Gao Yuanqiao's color was a little off. He said it and dropped his head again.

"Are you on the spectrum or something?" Yu Minghan tilted his chin up to get a better look, and found the other person's innocent, guileless expression rather reminded him of Tang Huan from before. He couldn't help wondering if the shampoo brand had picked Gao Yuanqiao for exactly that quality.

He didn't dwell on it, and said, "Weird. When I watched you on the show, you seemed pretty confident and sunny. What, did something happen to you?"

Gao Yuanqiao's heart jumped. He said nothing.

"Hey, are you a man or not? All this half-dead moping about, what's the point? You stole my friend's endorsement and I haven't even settled that score with you yet! Who did this to you? Tell me and I'll make them pay for it! A gentleman bides his time, but a real one gets it done in a year! We'll be scoundrels together and get even sooner!"

Gao Yuanqiao went from tears to a watery laugh.

Then with a slightly overwhelmed look, he said, "Am I the first artist you've ever signed?"

"No." Jiang Qing said. "Your separation from Ruihua won't happen overnight anyway, so by the time you join, we should already have another artist signed."

"Who?" Yu Minghan asked, curious.

"Zuo Xuan." Lin Xun cut in. "He's already in the middle of signing."

After their dinner with Han Yingguang, the director had taken Jiang Qing's words to heart and specifically tracked down this person called Zuo Xuan the very next day.

The moment he met him, he thought the look suited the role perfectly. After the screen test, he was thrilled, and immediately moved into negotiations.

Zuo Xuan was simultaneously overwhelmed and terrified of being tricked.

After years of going around unnoticed, he had never experienced being cast as a male lead, let alone having someone come find him.

Han Yingguang, understanding his hesitation, introduced his own past work, then mentioned that he had secured investment, and that the only person attached to the project was Jiang Qing.

Zuo Xuan was stunned. "Jiang Qing?! Then why does he still need me for the male lead?"

"I can't quite figure it out myself. Jiang Qing personally recommended you, said you were ideally suited for the role, and agreed to take a lower billing." Han Yingguang said with deep feeling, then added, "Now that I've met you, I agree. You really are the right fit."

"You're telling me that not only did Jiang Qing recommend me, he's also going to play a supporting role to me?!" Zuo Xuan felt that the world had suddenly become slightly surreal, and wasn't sure whether Jiang Qing had lost his mind or if he himself was dreaming.

"Yes!" Han Yingguang told him with full sincerity. "You've found a rare champion in Jiang Qing. So, are you willing to give it a try?"

Zuo Xuan's hands were shaking as he signed the contract, and still couldn't believe it.

Not until half a month later, when Jiang Qing's manager personally showed up to sign him as an artist, and mentioned she could prepay him in advance, did he go completely limp on the sofa.

Whatever the case, out of deep gratitude, he signed with this new company without looking back.

Even if he sometimes felt they had come to him only because it was a new company and he was a small-time nobody, Lin Xun had money, and Jiang Qing was a Best Actor. Even just catching the broth from that kind of setup was better than drifting along like he had been.

He believed this company, with its obvious eye for things, would surely go on to great success.

He was going to work hard, and not embarrass the people who believed in him. He was the first person personally identified by both Jiang Qing and Lin Xun!

"Zuo Xuan?" Yu Minghan rummaged around in his not-particularly-well-equipped brain and came up empty, his expression full of question marks. "Where'd you dig up this person from the wilderness? Your first signing and you've got this little sense? The people watching from the sidelines in the industry will be laughing their wigs off."

"You have no vision." Jiang Qing said with superior satisfaction. He had lived three extra years, after all. He understood the ups and downs of the big screen very well.

It was just that back then he'd paid little attention to variety shows and trending stars, so he didn't know where the likes of Yu Minghan and Gao Yuanqiao had ended up. But at least in his past life, neither of them had made it into major films.

In truth, the television world and the film world were quite different. Even if you ruled the television landscape and dominated variety shows, that didn't automatically get you into major film productions.

For one thing, audiences expected more from film. Cheap, slapped-together productions or films without substance would show it immediately in both the box office and the reviews. The audiences also didn't entirely overlap. Serious filmgoers had a near-allergic response to trending-star-led films.

For another, reality shows and built-up personas were a liability. Once you had been extensively exposed in front of the public with a particular image, it became very hard for audiences to immerse themselves in your character on screen.

There were other reasons too, such as the fact that director circles had their own hierarchy and unspoken chains of contempt. The Beijing-circle directors' films were the most impenetrable for trending stars.

Thinking about it, he looked at Yu Minghan again. This one was going to be in the second male lead of Yu Haoge's new film, and he found himself curious. "How did you end up being cast in Hao-ge's new film?"

"Ha, listen, don't go spreading this around. I'm only telling you lot, and if it leaks, it was definitely one of you, and I won't let any of you off the hook!" Yu Minghan was serious for about three seconds, then grinned. "He's my aunt's husband! My aunt hounded him for over a month, plus my dad put up a lot of money for the production, and he only reluctantly agreed to let me play the second male lead. Starts shooting soon."

Everyone: "......"

Jiang Qing genuinely hadn't known about that connection. The meetings with Yu Haoge had all been work-related, and at the wedding he had only gone the once, so he had rarely encountered the sister-in-law.

The atmosphere around the table was good. By the end of the meal, empty bottles stood all across the table.

Excluding Sang Yi, all the grown men had drunk themselves into a stupor, splayed and slumped across the sofa.

Yu Minghan was on the floor doing a crawl, giving everyone a private performance of Animal Planet.

Lin Xun was about as drunk as the rest of them, just a red face, without the actual loss of control.

If Jiang Qing had been sober at that moment, he would have realized this person had been faking it the last time, and would certainly have punched him good and hard for it.

But Jiang Qing had already gotten to the point of not seeing faces clearly, and was hollering at the person on the floor. "Look! A live turtle!"

Lin Xun: "Yes yes, you're absolutely right."

Sang Yi: "......"

"Yi-yi, you go on home. I'll get someone to pick up the rest of them." Lin Xun said.

"Okay." Sang Yi was almost at the door when she remembered her phone was on the sofa, went back for it, and found Yang Meng the drunk had picked it up and was taking selfies.

She snatched it out of his hand, gave his head a firm push, and Yang Meng listed sideways and rolled to the floor, where he and Yu Minghan came to rest staring at each other.

"Two turtles now!" Jiang Qing cheered.

Sang Yi walked out without looking back. Lin Xun called Yang Meng's assistant, who arrived quickly to collect him.

Yang Meng was carried out still shouting, "Come, let us drink to our friendship! Anyone who doesn't drink isn't Chinese!"

"Off you go." Lin Xun laughed and closed the door, phone in hand containing solid video evidence of his antics.

Lin Xun then looked at the remaining three drunks, reached out to Shu Tong for Zhao Lianchuan's contact.

Zhao Lianchuan walked in to find Yu Minghan causing trouble again, and thought privately that if footage of this got out, he'd have nowhere left to put his face. Who wouldn't laugh at him for managing such a disaster?

Lin Xun said, "Sorry for calling on you so late."

Zhao Lianchuan's eyelid twitched. He felt somehow that the sentence wasn't finished, and gave a polite cough. "I was joking earlier. A man of my age can hardly be doing that every night. You understand."

Saying it, he saw Lin Xun's expression shift from blankness to dawning realization, and mentally gave himself a solid punch.

Lin Xun hadn't been thinking anything of the sort! What on earth did he bring it up for!

After Zhao Lianchuan hauled Yu Minghan away, only Gao Yuanqiao was left.

Gao Yuanqiao lived alone, with no one to come for him.

Lin Xun couldn't leave either, so he cleared out a guest room on the first floor, dragged the person in, and left a lamp on.

After doing all this, he sank into the sofa, exhausted.

Everyone had been drinking. How was he the only one left functioning? Was that human? Was that fair?

"Mm......" From across the room, Jiang Qing suddenly made a sound.

Lin Xun looked straight over.

Jiang Qing's eyes were barely open, lids fluttering, not quite asleep. His hair had been rubbed into a mess against the sofa, his face flushed, his hand tugging at his collar to fan himself, the line of his collarbone dipping in and out of view.

Lin Xun's throat moved. He drank a glass of cold water before walking over to Jiang Qing's side and asking, "Ready to go home?"

It took Jiang Qing a long time to respond. He shook his head. "Mm, don't want to move."

Then he curled up his legs, tucked himself into the sofa, and contentedly settled in to sleep.

Lin Xun smiled a little, lifted the person in his arms, and walked upstairs, only then remembering he hadn't made up the spare room, so he brought him to the master bedroom first.

When he was at the wardrobe pulling out fresh bedding, he heard a rustling sound from behind him. He turned around, and nearly had a nosebleed on the spot.

Perhaps feeling warm, Jiang Qing had on instinct pulled off his top, and was hugging the bedding and turning over. His long, lean legs were casually draped across the covers, his pale, slender back fully exposed to the air, shoulder blades faintly raised, two small dimples at the small of his back, the physical lines of his figure remarkably fine.

Do not look. Looking would be a catastrophe.

Lin Xun quickly found a loose white T-shirt, helped the person sit up, and said softly, coaxing him. "Put this on. The air conditioning is on, don't catch a chill."

He slipped it over him, guided the arms out through the sleeves, and once it was on, he couldn't bring himself to move away.

Because the other person had completely gone limp and was resting against him, and right now it felt very much like having a beautiful person in one's arms.

He sat there holding him for a while, and then traced a finger from Jiang Qing's brow down to the bridge of his nose, and leaned down to brush his nose gently against that nose, smiling quietly. "I'm not going to be able to hold out much longer. Wake up, I have something to tell you."

"I quite like you."

"I want to hold you in the open."

"Jiang Qing."

Jiang Qing stirred.

chapters.title: Almost Can't Hold On
chapters.content:
Lin Xun froze for just a second, rapidly composing his response in his mind, waiting for the other person to wake up and demand an explanation.

But the other person seemed to only be uncomfortable with the sleeping position and wanted to shift, and burrowed his head further into Lin Xun's chest.

A little unreasonable, this.

Initiating contact without taking responsibility is just taking liberties.

Lin Xun sighed and helped this nuisance lie down properly, then went to wash up.

As for the guest room, forget it. Too tired.

After his shower, he lay down carrying the faint scent of orange body wash. The person beside him, drawn by the scent, immediately curled toward him.

Still a nuisance stray dog.

"So this is what you like." Lin Xun murmured with quiet amusement.

"Mm......" Jiang Qing replied without awareness, only feeling that the pillow was very comfortable, fragrant and soft, and so he wrapped himself around it with all four limbs.

Lin Xun: "......"

This was a little touching, but also something of a fire hazard.

He was just thinking that through when the other person's hand found his chest and gave it an absent-minded rub, and then his head nuzzled against his neck, carrying the energy of a lit fuse, setting off small fires in every direction.

Lin Xun recited a passage of scripture in his head before he managed to quiet himself down.

He extended his right hand under Jiang Qing's head, fingers idly curling around the ends of his hair.

Jiang Qing settled onto his arm quite naturally, then shifted onto his side, draping half of himself over Lin Xun.

Lin Xun breathed in slowly, reached for his phone on the nightstand, and in the low light of the dark room, quietly took one more photo of him sleeping.

A record of the body's unusual state.

Outside, the sun gradually climbed above the horizon. Light came through a gap in the curtain and fell in a small bright patch across the bed.

On that large bed lay two men with fine, precise features, quietly holding each other in stillness.

At some point, Jiang Qing was startled awake by a nightmare.

He opened his eyes in confusion, and the first thing that came into focus was Lin Xun's high, clean-lined nose and the thick lashes pressed shut like dark feathers. The skin was genuinely flawless. Even at this distance, there were no pores to speak of......

Wait. This distance.

He came fully awake in an instant.

He looked down at the two of them and realized he had been using the other person as a sleeping pillow. He pressed his palm to his own forehead in self-reproach, knocking away the last of his morning temper in the process.

Then he very slowly drew back his legs, preparing to slip quietly out of bed.

"Awake?"

He had barely pushed himself upright when a low, magnetic voice came from behind him, carrying the faint freshness of early morning in its tone.

He went rigid all at once, with the distinct sensation of having been caught doing something he shouldn't. He turned to find Lin Xun's eyes curved in a slight smile, and murmured back something incoherent.

Lin Xun took in his expression and put on a pitiful look. "My arm is so numb."

Jiang Qing glanced at the right arm, and said awkwardly, "I did that?"

"Mm."

Jiang Qing pressed his lips together, sat back cross-legged, and rubbed the arm for him. "Is that better?"

"Gentler." Lin Xun smiled.

"That, uh...... I didn't do anything embarrassing last night, did I?" Jiang Qing eased up the pressure, bent forward slightly and asked with caution.

The clothes he was wearing were ones that even Lin Xun would find somewhat loose. On him they were even baggier, and when he leaned forward like this, the neckline dipped just enough to reveal a sliver of his chest, the delicate collarbone put fully on display.

"You did." Lin Xun said, his eyes going deep, and then under the other person's curious gaze added, "You said you were going to marry me."

"Nonsense! Absolutely not!" Jiang Qing pinched his arm in irritation, and whether it was true or not, he could not stay here a moment longer.

He swung himself off the bed with swift agility, stretched, and noticed the clothes weren't his.

"Terrible taste. These are ugly." He said dismissively, as though his morning temper had crawled back into him, and spun around sharply, pressing one foot onto Lin Xun's leg and narrowing his eyes. "Why didn't you bring me home last night?"

"You didn't want to go home yourself. You refused to leave."

"Didn't you have another room?"

"Gao Yuanqiao was in it."

"He's here too?" The focus shifted immediately. "I'll go check on him."

Once the person had left the room, Lin Xun looked down at his leg, and helplessly rubbed his own head.

A good thing it was the leg. An inch or two higher and he might have lost something important.

He locked the door and took care of the first order of business of the morning in the master bathroom.

Jiang Qing went down to the guest room door and called Gao Yuanqiao's name softly. No answer came. Satisfied, he headed back home.

He went straight to the bathroom the moment he was inside. Men in the early morning all had more or less the same situation, and it was the first time he'd shared a bed with someone else. Being walked in on mid-situation would have been awkward.

After taking care of that, he undressed and showered. Once changed into his own clothes, he picked up Lin Xun's shirt, looked at it for a while, and threw it into the washing machine.

While drying his hair, he half-closed his eyes and tried to recall the nightmare from last night. The memory was vague. There was a sense of something flashing through and then slipping away before he could grasp it.

What had he been dreaming about?

He couldn't bring it back, so he let it go, and picked up his phone to check for any important messages.

After scrolling through all the usual apps, he noticed his QQ acquaintance had posted something on their feed at around 3:30 in the morning.

[Little Mushroom Picking Girl]: Can't sleep. No dreams. Missing you.

Was this what the romance of the younger generation looked like?

The Mushroom's profile said born in 2008, and here was this person losing sleep over romance at such a young age. What inexhaustible energy.

He casually hit like.

The next moment, Little Mushroom came looking for him to share feelings.

[Little Mushroom Picking Girl]: Good morning, Little Matchgirl.

Jiang Qing was a little surprised. Staying up that late, and awake this early? Truly the boundless energy of youth.

The Queen of the Night herself.

Mushroom asked again: [Little Matchgirl, does anyone like you?]

He typed back with some self-satisfaction: [Yes.]

[Little Mushroom Picking Girl]: Have you been confessed to?

This was getting a little personal, but he guessed this young person was deep in some romantic feelings right now, and possibly going through the particular ache of a one-sided love.

He immediately thought of those news stories he'd seen before about middle schoolers going off the rails for love, and decided to pull the young girl back from the edge.

[Little Matchgirl selling matches]: Yes, but I rejected them firmly. Because my heart belongs only to my studies! We must shoulder the great responsibility of our nation's glorious revival!

[Little Mushroom Picking Girl]: Good for you! But I'm planning to confess to someone. Any advice?

[Little Matchgirl selling matches]: My advice is don't.

[Little Mushroom Picking Girl]: ......Why?

[Little Matchgirl selling matches]: What if it doesn't work? Can you still focus on your studies? And if it does work, you definitely won't be focusing on your studies either.

[Little Mushroom Picking Girl]: ......You're genuinely a life coach. But I've already given up on studying.

Gasp! Had the young girl already gone off the rails?!

[Little Matchgirl selling matches]: What kind of person could make you abandon your studies entirely!

Half a minute passed before the reply came. It stopped him cold.

[Little Mushroom Picking Girl]: The one who runs through my mind and brings me to ruin.

The doorbell rang. He put down his phone and went to answer it, and it wasn't Lin Xun as he had expected, but Gao Yuanqiao.

"Senior, I'm heading back. Yesterday was so much fun. It was the best day I've had."

"Sleep well?"

"Very well!" Gao Yuanqiao smiled. "Senior, don't worry. I've made my peace with things. It's not the end of the world!"

"Mm. Go home and rest up. In a few days a manager and a lawyer will reach out to you. All you need to do is keep yourself in good shape. Next time I see you, I want to see the old you."

"Okay. Thank you, you and Xun-ge." Gao Yuanqiao bowed. "Take care of yourselves!"

After he left, Jiang Qing turned to look at the person standing in the doorway of the apartment next door, and said helplessly, "Talking to him always gives me the feeling of being someone's parent. And apparently he feels it too, going around telling us to take care of ourselves."

Lin Xun laughed quietly.

After his brief complaints, listening to that low, easy laughter, a flash of a dream image surfaced in his mind without warning, and on instinct he asked, "Did you by any chance say something like 'I quite like you'?"

Lin Xun looked straight at him.

"Oh! I think that was the nightmare I had last night!"

"......" Lin Xun went in and slammed the door.

"Ahh, how terrifying, ha ha ha ha ha." Jiang Qing laughed at the shut door. "What are you getting annoyed about? If you dreamed that I told you I liked you, you'd be scared awake too. Might even scare other things right off you."

The door opened. Lin Xun looked out with mild, unruffled eyes. "Actually, I wouldn't."

"Really?" Jiang Qing didn't buy that for a second, and gave him a playful look. "Lin Xun, I like you, I really really like you! I want to be with you!"

"Done. I agree."

"..........?"

You accepted that at such speed. Are you serious?

Jiang Qing was at a loss. "Come on, aren't you supposed to laugh at me a little right now?"

"Why would I laugh? You bravely declared your feelings. That deserves encouragement." Lin Xun said. "I accept. When's the ceremony?"

"......" There were truly no words.

He had figured it out now. You couldn't joke around with Lin Xun. Who knew when he would dig a pit in the opposite direction.

After breakfast, the two of them headed to the company for a meeting. Zuo Xuan was sitting rigidly in the conference room, staring at the door.

When Jiang Qing and Lin Xun walked in one after the other, with light, steady steps, Zuo Xuan found their looks so overwhelming he had a small crisis of confidence.

These two were a few years younger than him and infinitely better-looking, and also disgustingly rich.

Pathetic in comparison.jpg

Shu Tong and Guan Jingshan had worked together quite a bit in the past few days and, though their styles differed, had come to appreciate each other's abilities. They were complementing each other well.

Yang Meng, the nominal manager, was downstairs tied up with another company. They didn't need him here for now. As long as the money came through.

Everyone exchanged greetings, and Shu Tong said, "Zuo Xuan can formally sign today. The new manager is thirty-one, handles pressure well, and has a constructive, positive mindset. A good fit for Zuo Xuan."

"Good." Lin Xun nodded.

Shu Tong's many years of accumulated contacts were proving useful. She could quickly and accurately identify the right manager for each artist based on their character and development goals, and recruit them with a competitive salary.

Though some were still reluctant to join a brand-new company, having Ryan Investment behind them had attracted a number of talented people who were ready for a change.

A new company meant greater challenges, but also greater satisfaction. Getting an artist to break through meant both reputation and reward.

"The stylist is also on board. We'll take Zuo Xuan for a trial session after this, to figure out his look going forward. But you two need to be mindful of the stylist, especially Jiang Qing and Lin Xun." Shu Tong continued in her orderly fashion. "He's a bi. He was fired for confessing to a major celebrity during work hours."

Jiang Qing: "......"

Lin Xun: "......"

Zuo Xuan: ...... First time being grateful for being plain-looking?

"Moving on to artist plans. The company currently has the three of you, and with Gao Yuanqiao joining, that's four male artists." Shu Tong paused. "My suggestion is to sign one or two female artists as well, but that's not urgent. The most important thing right now is the film and television resources for you all.

"In terms of positioning, Jiang Qing is clearly going straight to the big screen. Zuo Xuan has taken the male lead in 'New Homeland,' so we won't have him doing variety shows or reality programs in the short term. For Gao Yuanqiao, he's new with no breakout work yet, so we'll assess his strengths closer to the time and decide between film, television, or variety."

"And then there's resources. Zuo Xuan doesn't need to worry there. Jiang Qing, taking a lower billing for Zuo Xuan will inevitably affect how directors perceive you, so you absolutely must take on a top-billed production next."

"I know." Jiang Qing said. "But right now, probably no one will dare put me at the top of anything, so let's focus on 'New Homeland' first."

Lin Xun glanced at him.

"That works. Once I'm done with the current rush, I'll look at what projects might suit you. Your scenes in 'New Homeland' aren't many. Push hard and we can have it wrapped in ten days......" Shu Tong talked for over half an hour before she had covered everything.

Then it was Guan Jingshan's turn to report. He was concise and direct. "The current contract for M.Jane's brand ambassador is expiring, and they are looking for a new face in China. Fashion Week is in half a month, and I have one invitation. Your fashion endorsement resources have been far too limited. Shu Tong, you've been too indulgent with him. If he doesn't want to do something, you let him skip it. That means the opportunity isn't in our hands."

Jiang Qing and Shu Tong both lowered their heads simultaneously. Truly a merciless overlord. Not a scrap of sentiment anywhere.

"M.Jane?" Lin Xun asked suddenly.

"Yes. The head designer Jane has been preparing this collection for a long time, and invitation slots are something people have been fighting over. I managed to secure one."

Lin Xun nodded thoughtfully.

Guan Jingshan moved on to other matters. "I've arranged several magazine cover shoots. While your exposure is solid right now, Jiang Qing, get a few high-end covers in quickly to attract brand attention."

"Understood." Jiang Qing accepted his arrangements without protest.

Back home, Lin Xun checked the time and made a call. A warm, melodic female voice answered. "Ahh, which precious darling is calling me?"

"It's me." Lin Xun said with a smile. "Auntie, Jane's show is in two weeks. You have extra tickets, don't you?"

"You go ages without a word and then the first thing out of your mouth is asking for tickets. You really do forget about your elders the moment you're all grown up." The woman let out a deep sigh. "I'll be performing there as a surprise guest. Are you coming?"

"Really?" Lin Xun was genuinely pleased. "Then Jane is very lucky. Since you're going, I'll definitely be there."

"I know you. You've always had to be physically pressed onto the piano bench before you'd lift a finger. What made you want to come to a fashion show?"

"I recently started a talent management company. I want to bring the artists along for some exposure." Lin Xun said.

"Look at you, going and quietly starting another company. Come, come! I'll quietly get you a few tickets."

"Two will be enough. Also, I'd like to recommend someone to Jane for the ambassador role."

"Oh, so that's what this is really about!" The woman's volume shot up, and then she laughed. "That's not something I have any say over."

Lin Xun softened his tone. "Auntie, just an introduction, that's all I need."

"Alright, alright. Fine. Send me his details and I'll put in a word."

Half an hour later, she called back. "Jane says bring this person to have a look. But she also has a request. She needs you to help her with something."

"What kind of something?" Lin Xun thought of Jane's look that so often carried an ulterior motive, and felt the first stirring of a bad feeling.

"Do a set as her model, or the two of us could play a piano duet...... or would you rather do violin?"

"......" Lin Xun said with good humor, "I'm fairly certain the second option is one you added yourself. You still haven't given up."

"Giving up is out of the question. If only you'd taken up my mantle, wouldn't that be wonderful. I don't care. Pick one, and let me know soon!"

The following two weeks were packed for Jiang Qing. Two magazine shoots in a single week, and every other day Guan Jingshan was driving him to the gym. An artist had to live by their looks and their physique, after all.

Magazine shoots, attending fashion events, these all required staying in shape.

Even on screen, the camera magnified a face by several times, so he couldn't afford to let his face round out.

With the cold, impassive Guan Jingshan watching over him, he didn't dare slack for a single moment.

He hadn't worked with Guan Jingshan long enough for the kind of mutual familiarity he and Shu Tong had built up over years, where each knew how far the other would bend.

And Guan Jingshan, without any ceremony, would secretly photograph him being lazy and drop the photos in the company group chat for everyone to weigh in on and mock. This was a treatment he had never once experienced before.

Truly embarrassing beyond measure.

Shu Tong, processing expansion matters for the management department at the office, expressed upon hearing this that he could go even harder. There was a palpable relief about her, like a parent who had finally successfully handed off their child.

On the time-management front, he was ordered to rise early and sleep early. At seven in the morning, Guan Jingshan would show up at his door and haul him off to exercise.

After two weeks, Jiang Qing felt like he'd been through a skin-shedding, though his weight had stayed within a lean, healthy range, and his skin was looking considerably better.

There was also the shortcut of going to an aesthetic clinic for a few injections, quick and simple.

But Jiang Qing was deeply afraid of anything like that. Just thinking about it made him anxious.

Besides, for a film actor, the golden years were somewhere between thirty and fifty. Looks weren't that critical. He had no desire to have his face go soft on screen one day.

And honestly, his features were a bit of a double-edged sword. Roles that were too rugged never really came to him, so the bulk of what he'd played had been the handsome-leading-man type.

When he finally got a day off, Jiang Qing realized that with his early departures and late returns each day, he had barely seen Lin Xun in quite a while.

The other person seemed to be busy too. Probably a lot of company matters to deal with.

But he hadn't expected that when he saw Lin Xun again, it would be on a plane.

He had just settled back when, out of the corner of his eye, someone stopped right beside him and stood there without moving.

He looked up, and was startled to find Lin Xun in a rare set of smart formal clothes, his hair carefully styled. "Why are you here?"

Lin Xun touched his cufflink and smiled. "You move fast. Didn't even wait for me."

"What do you mean? We're going to Fashion Week. The invitation only had one ticket." Jiang Qing sat up, looking up at him.

Lin Xun held his curious gaze for half a minute, then on an inexplicable impulse pinched his cheek. "Long time no see. It seems like you didn't miss me at all."

"That's not true!" Jiang Qing said on instinct. "I thought about you quite a bit. Since you're here anyway, let's go together."

Lin Xun deliberately kept his voice low, afraid of startling his own heartbeat, and said, "But what do we do? There's only one invitation."

Jiang Qing made a grabbing motion in the air and tucked it into his chest pocket, then patted his chest with great solemnity. "Then I'll put you in my pocket and sneak you in."

chapters.title: A Nightmare
chapters.content:
Lin Xun went rigid for just a moment, rapidly sorted out his thoughts, and waited for the other person to wake up right away and demand to know what had just been said.

But the other person only seemed to feel that the sleeping position wasn't quite comfortable enough, and burrowed his head deeper into Lin Xun's chest.

Really.

Physical contact without emotional responsibility is just taking liberties.

Lin Xun sighed, settled the nuisance lying down properly, and then went to wash up.

As for the guest room, he was not touching it. Too tired.

After his shower, a faint orange scent from the body wash clung to him, and the moment he lay down, the person beside him followed the scent and wrapped themselves around him.

Still a stray dog through and through.

"So this is your preference." Lin Xun murmured with quiet amusement.

"Mm......" Jiang Qing replied without consciousness, only feeling that the pillow was very comfortable, soft and fragrant, and very efficiently wrapped all four limbs around it.

Lin Xun: "......"

Somewhat touching. Also somewhat of a fire hazard.

He was just thinking this through when the other person's hand came to rest on his chest and gave it a drowsy rub, and then his head nuzzled against his neck, essentially a lit fuse going around setting off small fires everywhere.

Lin Xun recited a Buddhist sutra in his mind before he managed to quiet the chaos down.

His right arm extended under Jiang Qing's head. His fingers idly wound around the ends of his hair.

Jiang Qing settled onto his arm quite naturally, then turned onto his side, half his body draped over Lin Xun.

Lin Xun breathed in slowly, reached for his phone on the nightstand, and in the dim dark of the room quietly took one more photo of the sleeping face.

A record of a physiological anomaly.

Outside, the sun slowly rose. Light came through a gap in the curtain and fell in a small, bright patch on the bed.

On that large bed lay two men with fine and precise features, quietly holding each other in stillness.

At some point, Jiang Qing was startled awake by a nightmare.

He opened his eyes in a daze, and the first thing he saw was Lin Xun's high, clean bridge of a nose and the thick lashes pressed together like black feathers. His skin was genuinely something else. Even at this distance, there wasn't a pore in sight......

Wait. This distance.

He came fully awake in an instant.

He looked down at the position the two of them were in and realized he had been using the other person as a pillow. He pressed his palm against his own forehead in self-reproach, and knocked out the last traces of his morning temper in the process.

Then he very slowly drew back his legs, intending to slip quietly out of bed.

"Awake?"

He had just pushed himself upright when a low, magnetic voice came from behind him, carrying a faint thread of morning energy in its tone.

He went rigid all at once, with the distinct sensation of having been caught in the middle of doing something wrong. He turned his head to find Lin Xun's eyes curved in a slight smile, and mumbled something incoherent.

Lin Xun looked at his expression and put on a long-suffering face. "My arm is so numb."

Jiang Qing glanced at the right arm and said awkwardly, "Did I do that?"

"Mm."

Jiang Qing pressed his lips together, sat back into a cross-legged position, and rubbed the arm for him. "Is that better?"

"Gentler." Lin Xun smiled.

"So, uh, I didn't do anything too embarrassing last night, did I?" Jiang Qing eased up the pressure, bent forward slightly and asked with caution.

The clothes on him were ones that even Lin Xun found a little loose. On Jiang Qing they were even bigger, and when he leaned forward like this, the neckline dipped just enough to reveal a sliver of his chest, the clean line of his collarbone fully on display.

"You did." Lin Xun said, his gaze going deep, and then under the other person's curious look he said, "You said you were going to marry me."

"Rubbish! I did not!" Jiang Qing pinched his arm in irritation, and regardless of whether it was true, he absolutely could not stay here a moment longer.

He swung off the bed with brisk agility, stretched, and noticed the clothes weren't his.

"These look terrible." He said with disdain, as though the morning temper had crept back in. He turned around sharply, pressed one foot onto Lin Xun's leg and narrowed his eyes. "Why didn't you take me home last night?"

"You didn't want to go home yourself. You refused to leave."

"Didn't you have another room?"

"Gao Yuanqiao was in it."

"He's here too?" His focus jumped immediately. "Let me go check on him."

After the person had left the room, Lin Xun looked down at his leg and rubbed his own head in quiet resignation.

Lucky it was the leg. An inch or two higher and he might have caused a rather permanent problem for himself.

He locked the door and handled the first matter of the morning in the master bathroom.

Jiang Qing went to the guest room door and quietly called Gao Yuanqiao's name. No answer. Reassured, he headed back home.

He went straight to the bathroom the moment he was inside. Men in the early morning all dealt with a certain universal condition, and since it was his first time sharing a bed with someone else, being walked in on in that state would have been more than a little awkward.

After handling that, he undressed and showered. Once changed into his own clothes, he picked up Lin Xun's shirt, looked at it for a while, and tossed it into the washing machine.

While blow-drying his hair, he squinted and tried to piece together the nightmare from last night, but the memory wouldn't solidify. There was a sense of something flickering through and then vanishing before he could hold onto it.

What had he been dreaming about?

He couldn't recall, so he gave it up, and reached for his phone to check if anything important had come in.

After going through all his usual apps, he noticed his QQ friend had posted on their feed at around 3:30 in the morning.

[Little Mushroom Picking Girl]: Can't sleep. No dreams. Thinking of you.

Was this the romance of the younger generation?

The Mushroom's profile said born in 2008, and here was this person losing sleep over romance at such a young age. Such energy.

A self-proclaimed Queen of the Night.

He tapped like without thinking.

The next moment, Little Mushroom came looking for him to pour out feelings.

[Little Mushroom Picking Girl]: Good morning, Little Matchgirl.

Jiang Qing was a little surprised. They had been up so late, and awake this early? Truly the boundless vitality of the young.

Little Mushroom followed up: [Little Matchgirl, does anyone like you?]

He typed back with some smugness: [Yes.]

[Little Mushroom Picking Girl]: Have you ever been confessed to?

This was getting a little personal, but he suspected this young person was deep in the middle of romantic feelings, maybe even the specific ache of one-sided love.

He immediately thought of those news stories he had seen about middle schoolers going off the rails for love, and decided to do his part to pull this young girl back from the edge.

[Little Matchgirl selling matches]: Yes, but I rejected them firmly. Because my heart belongs only to my studies! We must shoulder the great responsibility of the nation's glorious revival!

[Little Mushroom Picking Girl]: Good for you! But I'm planning to confess to someone. Any advice?

[Little Matchgirl selling matches]: My advice is don't.

[Little Mushroom Picking Girl]: ......Why?

[Little Matchgirl selling matches]: What if it doesn't work out? Can you still focus on your studies? And if it does work out, you definitely can't focus on your studies either.

[Little Mushroom Picking Girl]: ......You're genuinely a life coach. But I've already dropped studying.

A shock! The young girl had already gone off the rails?!

[Little Matchgirl selling matches]: What kind of person could make you abandon your studies entirely!

Half a minute passed before the reply came. It stopped him cold.

[Little Mushroom Picking Girl]: The one who runs through my thoughts and brings me to ruin.

The doorbell rang. He put down his phone and went to the door, and it wasn't Lin Xun as he'd expected, but Gao Yuanqiao.

"Senior, I'm heading back. Yesterday was so much fun. It was the best day I've had."

"Sleep well?"

"Very well!" Gao Yuanqiao smiled. "Senior, don't worry. I've come to terms with things. It's not the end of the world!"

"Mm. Go home and rest. In a few days a manager and a lawyer will be in touch. All you need to do is stay in good shape. Next time I see you, I want to see the old you."

"Okay. Thank you, you and Xun-ge." Gao Yuanqiao bowed. "Take care of yourselves!"

After some time, Jiang Qing turned his head to look at the person standing in the doorway of the apartment next door, and said helplessly, "Every time I talk to that kid I get the feeling of being someone's father. And now it turns out he feels it too. He's telling us to take care of ourselves."

Lin Xun laughed quietly.

After his venting, listening to that low, easy laughter, a flash of a dream image surfaced in his mind without warning, and on instinct he asked, "Did you say something like 'I quite like you' at some point?"

Lin Xun looked straight at him.

"Oh! I think that must have been the nightmare last night!"

"......" Lin Xun went inside and slammed the door.

"Ahh, so terrifying, ha ha ha ha ha." Jiang Qing laughed at the shut door. "Why are you getting worked up? If you dreamed I told you I liked you, you'd be scared awake too. Might even scare other things right off you."

The door opened. Lin Xun looked out with a calm, unruffled gaze. "That actually wouldn't happen."

"Really?" Jiang Qing didn't believe a word of it, and gave him a playful look. "Lin Xun, I like you, I really really like you. I want to be with you!"

"Done. I agree."

"..........?"

He accepted that so fast. Is he serious?

Jiang Qing was at a loss. "Come on, shouldn't you be laughing at me right now?"

"Why would I laugh? You bravely declared your feelings. That deserves encouragement." Lin Xun said. "I accept this. When's the ceremony?"

"......" There were truly no words.

He had come to understand now. You could not joke around with Lin Xun. You never knew when he would dig a pit going the other way.

The two of them went to the company for a meeting after breakfast. Zuo Xuan was sitting rigidly in the conference room, staring at the door.

When Jiang Qing and Lin Xun walked in one after the other, moving with a light, composed steadiness, their looks were so overwhelming that Zuo Xuan had a minor crisis of confidence.

These two were a few years younger than him, infinitely better-looking, and also disgustingly wealthy.

Pathetic by comparison. jpg

Shu Tong and Guan Jingshan had spent the past few days working closely together and, though their styles were different, had each come to appreciate the other's capabilities. They were already complementing each other quite well.

Yang Meng, the nominal manager, was downstairs tied up with another company. He wasn't needed here for now. As long as the money came through.

Everyone exchanged greetings, and Shu Tong said, "Zuo Xuan can formally sign today. His new manager is thirty-one, handles pressure well, has a positive and constructive mindset. A good fit for Zuo Xuan."

"Good." Lin Xun nodded.

Shu Tong's many years of accumulated contacts were proving their worth. She could quickly and accurately match each artist with the right manager based on their qualities and development direction, then bring them on with a competitive package.

Some were still reluctant to join a brand-new company, but the backing of Ryan Investment had drawn in several capable people who were ready for a change.

A new company meant bigger challenges, but also greater satisfaction. Getting an artist to break through meant both reputation and reward.

"The stylist is also in place. We'll take Zuo Xuan for a consultation after this, to determine his look going forward. But you two will need to pay some attention to the stylist, especially Jiang Qing and Lin Xun." Shu Tong continued with her methodical reporting. "He identifies as bisexual. He was previously let go for confessing to a major celebrity while on the job."

Jiang Qing: "......"

Lin Xun: "......"

Zuo Xuan: ...... First time being thankful for having an average face?

"Moving on to artist development plans. The company currently has the three of you, and with Gao Yuanqiao joining, that's four male artists." Shu Tong paused. "My suggestion is to sign one or two female artists as well, but that's not pressing. The most important thing right now is your film and television resources.

"In terms of positioning, Jiang Qing is clearly going straight to the big screen. Zuo Xuan has taken the male lead in 'New Homeland,' so we won't have him in any variety or reality content in the short term. For Gao Yuanqiao, he's a newcomer without a breakout work, so we'll assess his strengths when the time comes and decide between film, television, or variety."

"And then resources. Zuo Xuan is fine on that front. Jiang Qing, taking a lower billing for Zuo Xuan will inevitably affect how directors see you, so you absolutely must take on a top-billed production next."

"I know." Jiang Qing said. "But right now, no one is likely to take a chance putting me at the top, so let's focus on 'New Homeland' first."

Lin Xun glanced at him.

"That works. Once I'm through the current rush I'll look into what projects might suit you. Your scenes in 'New Homeland' aren't many, so push and we can have it wrapped in ten days......" Shu Tong talked for over half an hour before finishing her report.

Then it was Guan Jingshan's turn. He was concise. "The current M.Jane brand ambassador contract is expiring and they're looking for a new face in China. Fashion Week is in two weeks and I secured one invitation slot. Your fashion endorsement resources have been far too limited. Shu Tong, you've been too accommodating. If he doesn't want to do something, you let him skip it. That means the opportunity stays out of our hands."

Jiang Qing and Shu Tong lowered their heads in unison. Truly a merciless force. Not a shred of sentiment.

"M.Jane?" Lin Xun asked suddenly.

"Yes. The head designer Jane has been preparing this collection for a long time, and invitation slots are something people have been fighting over. I secured one."

Lin Xun nodded thoughtfully.

Guan Jingshan continued. "I've arranged several magazine cover shoots. While your exposure is solid right now, Jiang Qing, get a few high-end covers in quickly to attract brand attention."

"Understood." Jiang Qing accepted all of it.

Back home, Lin Xun checked the time and made a call. A warm, melodic female voice answered. "And which dear one is calling me now?"

"It's me." Lin Xun said with a smile. "Auntie, Jane's show is in two weeks. You'll have spare tickets?"

"Ages without a word and the first thing you ask for is tickets. Truly, once they're grown there's no controlling them." The woman sighed deeply. "I'll be there as a surprise guest performer. Are you coming?"

"Really?" A genuine flicker of delight from Lin Xun. "Then Jane is very lucky. Since you're going, I'll definitely be there."

"I know you. It always took someone physically pressing you down onto the piano bench before you'd move a finger. What made you want to come to a fashion show?"

"I recently started a talent management company. I want to bring my artists along for some exposure." Lin Xun said.

"Look at you, quietly starting another company. Come, come. I'll quietly get you a few tickets."

"Two is enough. Also, I'd like to recommend someone to Jane as a potential ambassador."

"So that's what this is really about!" The woman's volume rose sharply, and then she laughed. "That's not something I have any say over."

Lin Xun softened his tone. "Auntie, just introduce us. That's all."

"Fine, fine. Send me his details and I'll put in a word."

Half an hour later, she called back. "Jane says bring this person and she'll have a look. But she also has one condition. She needs a favor from you."

"What kind of favor?" Lin Xun thought of the looks Jane often gave that were never quite innocent, and felt a faint prickle of something not good.

"Do a set as her model, or the two of us could do a piano duet together...... or would you prefer violin?"

"......" Lin Xun said with amusement, "I'm fairly certain that second option was one you added yourself. You still haven't given up on that."

"Giving up is impossible. If only you'd carry on my path, wouldn't that be wonderful? I don't care. Pick one, and get back to me soon!"

The next two weeks were packed for Jiang Qing. Two magazine shoots in one week alone, and Guan Jingshan drove him to the gym every other day. An artist had to live on their face and their physique.

Magazine shoots, fashion events, all of it required maintaining physical condition.

Even on screen, the camera magnified a face many times over, so he absolutely could not let it round out.

With the cold and exacting Guan Jingshan watching over him, he didn't dare slack for a single moment.

He hadn't worked with Guan Jingshan long enough to reach the kind of mutual familiarity he had with Shu Tong after years together, where each knew how far the other would push.

And Guan Jingshan, without ceremony, would secretly photograph him being lazy and drop the evidence in the company group chat for everyone to comment on and mock. This was a form of humiliation he had never in his life experienced before.

Truly mortifying.

Shu Tong, handling expansion work for the management department at the office, said upon hearing this that he could go even harder, and seemed to radiate a very specific relief, like a parent who had successfully handed off a child.

On the scheduling front, early to rise and early to bed. At seven in the morning, Guan Jingshan would be at his door to haul him off to exercise.

Two weeks in, Jiang Qing felt as though he had shed a layer of skin, though his weight had remained within a lean, healthy range, and his skin had improved considerably.

There was also the shortcut of going to a clinic for a few injections, fast and simple.

But Jiang Qing was deeply averse to anything like that. Just thinking about it made him anxious.

Besides, for a film actor, the golden years ran from roughly thirty to fifty. Looks weren't that critical. He had no desire to see his face go slack on screen one day.

And his features were in some ways a limitation. Roles requiring a truly rugged quality rarely came to him, which was why most of what he had played fell into the handsome-leading-man category.

When he finally got a day off, Jiang Qing realized that with his early departures and late returns, he had barely seen Lin Xun in quite a while.

The other person seemed busy too. Company matters, probably.

But he hadn't expected that the next time he saw Lin Xun would be on a plane.

He had just settled back when, out of the corner of his eye, someone walked up beside him and stopped, unmoving.

He looked up, and startled to find Lin Xun in formal clothes for once, his hair carefully done. "Why are you here?"

Lin Xun touched his cufflink and smiled. "You really do move fast. You couldn't have waited a little."

"What do you mean? We're here for Fashion Week. The invitation only had one slot." Jiang Qing sat up, looking up at him.

Lin Xun held his curious gaze for half a minute, then on an inexplicable impulse, pinched his cheek gently. "Long time no see. It seems like you didn't miss me at all."

"That's not true at all!" Jiang Qing said on instinct. "I did think about you. Since you're here, let's go together."

Lin Xun deliberately kept his voice low, wary of startling his own heartbeat. "But what do we do? The invitation only has one slot."

Jiang Qing made a grasping motion in the air, tucked it into his breast pocket, then patted his chest with great ceremony. "Then I'll put you in my pocket and sneak you in."

chapters.title: The Violin
chapters.content:
The plane landed locally at ten-thirty. The group made their way to the hotel, settled in briefly, and then went to the hotel restaurant for lunch.

Shu Tong had too much to handle at the company and stayed behind in China. The people who came along were Guan Jingshan and Sang Yi, plus a newly hired artist's assistant and the stylist Aivis.

Aivis had a clean-featured face, a light touch of makeup, and a soft, unhurried way of speaking, entirely unlike the heavy-made-up, flamboyantly gaudy image Jiang Qing had imagined.

When Aivis learned of this mental picture, he gave a delicate little laugh. "I'm nothing like those uncouth men. I'm a pure little white flower. I just wanted to make a good first impression here. Who knows, I might get lucky." With that, he tossed a flirtatious look at both him and Lin Xun, and even Sang Yi didn't escape.

"Your eyes having a seizure?" Jiang Qing asked.

Aivis: Hmph. ╭(╯^╰)╮

"Eat your food, Zhuang-sanbing." Lin Xun added, twisting the knife.

Aivis was only a stage name. As a veteran fashion stylist, one was required to have a grand and polished English name.

Even at a village entrance, there sat a master named Tony.

He absolutely refused to allow his pure and delicate exterior to house a soul named Zhang Sanzhuang.

"Lin Xun, you have successfully captured my attention." Aivis clenched his teeth. "Tonight I will be sneaking into your room and having my way with you!"

"Very brave. I'm terrified." Lin Xun said, completely unmoved, then turned to look at Jiang Qing. "You can bunk with me tonight then."

"......" Jiang Qing bestowed a blank look on each of them with perfect impartiality.

After the meal, everyone returned to their rooms to recover from the jet lag. Aivis stood in the corridor in front of his room door, leaning against the wall in an 'S' curve, saying sweetly, "Lin Xun~~ call me when you're done in the shower ~~~"

He had barely finished performing his languorous scene when Guan Jingshan gave him a kick into the room.

Jiang Qing showered and collapsed onto the soft bed, and had a comfortable nap.

When he woke up, the sky outside had gone golden with late afternoon.

The sidewalk plane trees were catching the warm hue of the setting sun, and the river was overlaid with a thin, faint wash of orange. People walked at a leisurely pace, and the traveling street performers who loved to sing were setting up for their evening shows.

He watched from the balcony for a while, then decided to take a walk outside. He had just opened the door when he found Lin Xun appearing to have just come back from somewhere, a violin case in hand.

"You went out?"

"Mm. Rested?" Lin Xun came nearer and asked.

"Mm. Thinking of going for a walk." He dropped his gaze to the violin case. "What were you doing?"

"Went to see someone. They insisted on hearing me play." Lin Xun said, sounding quite resigned.

Jiang Qing was mildly surprised. "Do you play?"

"Yes. Would you like to hear?" Lin Xun perked up.

Jiang Qing let him in with skeptical curiosity, watching him open the case and lift out the violin, his hands careful and deliberate, and asked with honest interest, "Why do you seem to know how to do everything?"

"Giving birth is the one thing I can't manage."

Lin Xun said it with a wry lightness, then picked up the bow, looked around the room, and walked out to the balcony. He turned so his back was to the setting sun.

He raised the violin to his shoulder. His right hand held the bow, fingers curved in a natural, easy arc. He looked up and met Jiang Qing's eyes for a moment, and then slowly drew the first note from the instrument.

A warm, melodious sound unfurled slowly, flowing up over the balcony and landing in the high crowns of the plane trees, settling onto the broad and gentle surface of the river, drifting into the accompaniment of the impassioned street performers below, and falling into the eyes of Jiang Qing, standing a few meters away.

The sight left Jiang Qing momentarily elsewhere. The music pulled him briefly out of the noise of ordinary concerns, and his eyes held nothing but the solitary figure playing across from him.

He wasn't sure how long had passed before the last note was drawn to a close, and Lin Xun slowly opened his eyes. His profile seemed to have been gilded by the last of the sunset light, beautiful in a way that didn't seem quite real.

"Did you like it?" Lin Xun asked, in a low voice.

Jiang Qing nodded, a little dazed. "Yes. Very much."

"I've never played this piece for anyone before. You're my first listener." Lin Xun smiled, stepped back into the room, placed the violin in its case, and said with a small sigh, "What a waste, this good a violin left in my hands."

"Mm? You played beautifully. How is that a waste?" Jiang Qing walked over to the case, looked at it. "Is it a very valuable instrument?"

"Over two hundred years old. The previous owner was a violinist who passed away. My aunt spent a great deal of effort acquiring it, with the hope of turning me into a violinist. Or a pianist...... in any case, she always hoped I would take the path she took, find my way into music."

Jiang Qing looked at him blankly. "You don't love music?"

"I enjoy it, but I don't want it to be the work of my entire life." Lin Xun closed the case with an almost imperceptible breath. "People in my family always place some kind of hope in me, wanting me to venture into their field. But once I've learned something, it's hard to stay interested. So I've always admired you a little, having a direction you can keep working toward."

Jiang Qing understood. This person had simply been spoiled by talent. His natural abilities were so considerable that he picked everything up easily, and because it wasn't something he truly loved, he lost interest just as quickly.

For dinner, Lin Xun took him out. He had half-expected somewhere decent, even if not Michelin-starred, at least a proper French meal.

Instead, the other person took them on a half-hour bus ride, down a narrow alley, and eventually to a small restaurant.

The owner was a plump woman with beautiful blue eyes, who asked them in French what they would like.

Jiang Qing looked around. The space was small but filled with customers, most of them parents with young children, and the shelves were lined with all manner of adorable small cakes.

Then he heard Lin Xun say something in a string of French.

He had no idea what any of it meant, and was too embarrassed to ask.

After ordering, Lin Xun led him by the arm upstairs.

Jiang Qing's eyes lit up, and then immediately fell. "You think I would like somewhere like this?"

A place covered in toys and pink plush dolls and stuffed animals?

There were cute figurines on the table, puzzles on the chairs, the whole thing felt like a children's play space, and in the seat next to them a small girl was sitting quietly at her table playing with a Barbie doll.

"I think you'll like the taste here." Lin Xun smiled, and led him to a corner, pulling out a chair for him. "Please."

Jiang Qing looked around and asked, "Is this one of those hidden gems that locals know about?"

"Mm. The owner's child went missing more than ten years ago. She's been here ever since, making the food children love most, hoping that someday her child will find their way back to this taste." Lin Xun said. "The food is very good. Sweet but not cloying. Children love it."

"And what about adults?"

"When children are happy, the adults are happy too."

"But the thing is, I'm not a child." Jiang Qing said dryly.

"In my mind, you are." Lin Xun clasped his hands on the table and leaned his chin on them, his eyes curving with a smile. "Your treasure room is genuinely remarkable. I'd really love to go exploring in there."

Jiang Qing's first instinct was to assume he was being teased for being childish, but looking at the sincerity in the other person's eyes, he swallowed what he'd been about to say, and changed it to, "Then come help me put together that Transformer next time."

Lin Xun was briefly still, and after a moment said, "Alright."

Inviting a person into that kind of interior space, a room that held one's quietest private things, and asking them to come play, was in a certain sense the opening of a door.

Lin Xun smiled, and it reached his eyes.

The owner brought the food over. Two plates of steak and lemon water, alongside an array of charming little pastries that were very pleasing just to look at.

Outside the window, a cluster of children had gathered at the glass, noses pressed in, staring at the cakes they wanted with earnest longing.

The taste was, unexpectedly, remarkably good. On the way back, Lin Xun found a horse-drawn carriage.

The two of them sat together, lazily taking in the romantic scenery along the street.

The driver was also a lover of song, and began to sing in a rich, low, magnetic voice.

Lin Xun joined in and called and answered with him. Jiang Qing didn't know the words, but his mood was light and bright, and he hummed along with a few notes.

The driver looked back with a pleased smile.

Just then, a small child darted out from the roadside. The driver yanked at the reins, and the seat jolted.

Jiang Qing was thrown off balance and leaned into Lin Xun beside him. In the next second, the other person's arms locked around him firmly, enclosing him. "Careful."

Jiang Qing had his hand braced on Lin Xun's leg, trying to sit upright, but the carriage swayed again, and Lin Xun pulled him closer.

He gave up on struggling and let the other person hold him around the shoulders, and settled back against him with considerable comfort to watch the scenery drift by above and below.

When they reached the hotel, Lin Xun gave the driver a generous tip.

The driver winked at him and asked in French, "Thank you. If you don't mind my asking, are you two lovers? I think you're very well suited."

"What are you two saying?" Jiang Qing asked from the side.

Lin Xun translated: "He says you're very handsome."

"Thanks." Jiang Qing said to the driver.

The driver nodded knowingly, with a warm laugh. "Goodbye, lovely couple."

"Goodbye." Lin Xun's mood was excellent, and left a little extra in the tip.

Jiang Qing watched the driver's retreating figure and couldn't help remarking, "What a way with words."

Lin Xun nodded. Yes, rather skilled, wasn't he.

The two of them had barely reached the entrance when they ran into Guan Jingshan and the others returning from their search for food.

At the sight of them, Guan Jingshan, in a rare moment, showed visible excitement, and his smile was unsettling enough that his roommate Aivis felt a chill.

"We need to have a quick meeting." Guan Jingshan said.

In Lin Xun's room, the six of them sat in various positions. Guan Jingshan closed the door and went straight to the point with barely contained excitement. "The organizer has sent us two VIP invitation cards specifically. Front row, center seats!"

The more he thought about it, the more worked up he got. Fashion Week seats, as a rule, were obtained either through brand invitations or via magazine and media channels. There were also those without enough prestige who paid their own way in just to be in a camera shot.

But brand invitations were the hardest resources to come by. Generally only brand ambassadors or official representatives received them, and usually there was only one or two.

In most cases, access came through media partnerships. He had spent the past few weeks having Jiang Qing shoot for magazines specifically to secure a slot through the publications.

Jiang Qing and Lin Xun were neither ambassadors nor had they ever worked with this brand, and yet the brand had proactively sent them this caliber of seats. Did this mean the ambassador position was within reach?

Jiang Qing also found himself at a loss. Logically, a brand would never reach out this close to the event with invitations. And he had had no prior contact with them at all. How had they ended up with such prime placement?

Was he really going to be competing with a crowd of beautiful people in front of all those cameras?

Please just end him now. He was going to get attacked no matter what.

Guan Jingshan added, "There's another possibility. You and Lin Xun wore the same style of brooch on the show, and it's an M.Jane piece. After the show aired, the sales of that brooch jumped several times over. Perhaps the brand has noticed your influence on consumer buying?"

"Maybe?" Jiang Qing said, not entirely certain.

"Anyway, that's not the point. We'll know tomorrow. Oh, and they've also personally sent two complete new high-end custom looks over. They'd like you both to wear them at the show tomorrow!"

Jiang Qing suspected there was something more going on here, but couldn't quite place where the catch was.

He glanced around without thinking, and noticed everyone seemed quite excited. Everyone except Lin Xun.

The other person was smiling faintly, and did not look particularly surprised.

Surely...... not.

Did he know someone at the brand? What kind of connection would it take to secure this kind of treatment?

He was probably reading too much into it.

That evening, Guan Jingshan ordered them to apply a face mask and get to sleep, then went back to his own room to instruct Aivis to plan out tomorrow's looks in advance and make sure they worked with the clothes.

Jiang Qing lay on the bed with his mask on, scrolling his phone, and thought of the violin photo he'd taken in the late afternoon. He shared it to his Weibo burner and his QQ burner.

[@Ponytail Boy] / [Little Matchgirl selling matches]: Sharing a photo. [image]

He went back to the Lavender fan group, where everyone was discussing Lin Xun's and his own schedule.

The official studio account had only posted a few airport photos after they had landed, and no return date had been announced.

"Can we see Lin Zong and Jiang Qing looking gorgeous at Fashion Week!!"

"Lin Zong is in a suit! His legs look so long!!! [heart eyes]"

"Xun-ge and Jiang Qing weren't on the same flight? They didn't just have a falling out over the studio already, did they?"

"I think they're each afraid that showing up together would double the devastation, and they'd obliterate the entire airport, so they're moving separately."

"...... I actually find that slightly convincing ha ha ha ha"

"Can't wait for high-res photos from the show! Give us a photo of them together!"

The studio had also made one official announcement, that Zuo Xuan would soon become the first signed artist of Ruijiang Studio.

This news baffled not only the fans, but people inside the industry too.

Looking at other artists' studios, every single one of them was signing young newcomers with obvious potential, each more youthful and better-looking than the last.

Ruijiang Studio, on the other hand, had attracted considerable attention at launch, and when people saw that the first new artist was a thirty-something, completely unremarkable background performer, there was simply nothing left to anticipate.

Then, that same afternoon, a production account called "New Homeland" posted an official announcement saying that this artist named Zuo Xuan would be playing the male lead.

Which was, in isolation, unsurprising. No-name team uses no-name actor. In ordinary times, barely anyone would have paid attention.

The strange part was that the official cast list included Jiang Qing. And judging by position and photo order, he was not playing the top-billed role.

What kind of arrangement was this?

You didn't promote newcomers like this.

Look more carefully, and it was a science fiction film. A film like this...... not flopping would genuinely be a miracle. Not even Jiang Qing could save the box office.

Industry observers were watching for the entertainment. The fans were close to tears.

"I just saw Wang Mingzhi's fans mocking our Qing-ge for his projects, saying he's going to flop. I'm so angry, I want to go at them!"

"It's not just Wang Mingzhi's fans. Several other fandoms are quietly laughing too."

"Have some faith in Qing-ge."

"Honestly, I went and looked at Zuo Xuan's background. It's really...... well. I just hope he doesn't disappoint everyone."

"Let's visit the set later! Buy as many tickets as we can!"

"Please, Lavender sisters, trust Jiang Qing. His instincts for scripts are top tier. He would sooner take nothing than take a bad project. This film definitely has something special about it. Can't wait!"

"Okay! Didn't expect us Lavenders and the Jiang fans to now be on the same team ha ha ha ha. So many Jiang-fan sisters have joined the group."

"From now on we're family! Looking out for each other!"

Jiang Qing: Thank you all. Genuinely moved.

At that moment, his little online friend gave his post a like, and commented: Nice.

Then he received a private message from Little Mushroom.

[Little Mushroom Picking Girl]: Do you really like violin?

[Little Matchgirl selling matches]: Mm. The sound is very beautiful.

[Little Mushroom Picking Girl]: What's your favorite piece?

Jiang Qing thought carefully, and realized he had never really listened to or paid attention to violin music before, not until today, when something in him had been struck by a string he couldn't name.

[Little Matchgirl selling matches]: This afternoon a friend played a piece for me that was incredibly beautiful, but I don't know what it was called.

The other side didn't reply immediately. He got up to peel off his face mask, and his phone buzzed.

[Little Mushroom Picking Girl]: Then ask your friend to play you more. I'm sure he would be very happy to. Get some rest.

[Little Matchgirl selling matches]: Mm. Goodnight.

Jiang Qing took off the mask, checked the time, and went to sleep early.

On the other side, Lin Xun's lips curved, and he made a call to his aunt.

"I won't be playing violin tomorrow."

"Why! Don't tell me you'd rather wear Jane's clothes?!"

"No." Lin Xun smiled quietly, looking down. "I just suddenly don't feel like playing violin for strangers anymore."

"Oh? That's an interesting thing to say." His aunt said with distinct meaning.

"Mm. Didn't you also have a piece you didn't want to play for just anyone?"

"That's completely different! That piece I composed specifically for my beloved!"

A peculiar silence.

"Oh my god!" A woman's stunned cry from the other end of the line. "You composed this yourself?!"

Lin Xun: "......"

"No, no, wait. You...... you have a beloved?! I thought you were emotionally detached?!"

Lin Xun: "............"

chapters.title: The Confession
chapters.content:
Early the next morning, Guan Jingshan and Aivis descended on Jiang Qing's room to do his makeup and styling. They then shot a few sets of photos in the hotel, which were sent back to the studio in China.

Walking out, Jiang Qing noticed Lin Xun wasn't in his room and wasn't in the car. He asked, "Where is he?"

"He had something come up and left earlier. He just messaged to say he's already at the venue. We can head over now." Guan Jingshan pulled the car door shut.

The venue had already seen quite a few arrivals, people taking photos and video everywhere.

Under Guan Jingshan's guidance, he went straight inside. The seats around the T-stage were already well filled on both sides.

Their arrival time was already ahead of schedule, but others had been even more diligent. Arriving late to a fashion show left a very poor impression.

Major media reporters, fashion bloggers, and buyers were standing or seated in the back rows, and the first-row seats had become the most coveted positions in the room.

Cameras and flash were going off constantly, capturing every celebrity in the front rows. When Jiang Qing walked in, he drew no particular attention, until he moved toward the front row and took a seat in the very center, at which point the camera operators and the artists around him all looked up in startled curiosity.

Jiang Qing was wearing a relaxed, well-tailored suit, elegant and effortless, with a small bamboo-leaf-shaped brooch pinned to the lapel, which immediately brought to mind his panda brooch from before, adding a touch of playful charm to an otherwise composed look.

His slightly long hair had been set in a wave and pulled back into a small clip, with a strand falling beside his ear, his skin clear and bright, and the understated makeup made his features all the more striking.

And the suit he was wearing bore the M.Jane exclusive logo, though both bloggers and buyers who noticed it quickly recognized that this style had not yet appeared in the market. Ruling out the possibility of a fake, there was only one conclusion: this was an upcoming new release.

Other artists were surprised, but with cameras everywhere, everyone kept their expressions and composure in check, exchanged polite nods and smiles, and turned back to their own affairs.

There was one exception. Yu Minghan came out of nowhere and tapped him on the shoulder from behind.

Jiang Qing turned to look, and broke into a grin. "You're here too?"

"Yeah, didn't you know?" Yu Minghan looked a little put-out, then said under his breath, "Your company's people gave us the invitations. Your manager basically showed up at my door last night and dragged me here."

Jiang Qing got it. They'd had a spare invitation, and Guan Jingshan had used it as a favor to Yu Minghan. Sharp as ever.

Yu Minghan looked him over and said, "That outfit looks great. Where's it from? I want one."

Jiang Qing was about to reply when someone appeared behind Yu Minghan and grabbed at his collar and yanked it sideways.

"Hey hey, who is that...... Lin Xun, easy, so many people watching, give me a little face here." Yu Minghan grumbled, keeping his voice down, while maintaining a surface appearance of brotherly harmony.

Lin Xun settled calmly into the seat beside Jiang Qing, and said, "The show's about to start. Go sit down."

Yu Minghan drifted away reluctantly, muttering, "Lao Jiang, wait for me after."

Jiang Qing said he would, then heard Lin Xun ask, "Wait for him to do what?"

"He invited me to go shopping."

"Shopping for what? What is there to buy? Haven't you got enough packages arriving at home as it is?"

"......" Jiang Qing quietly gave him a look. "Would you stop it? You're ruining my image."

The two of them spoke quietly to each other as though no one else existed, entirely unaware of the curious stares coming from every direction.

Before long, the fashion show officially began.

Jiang Qing sat up straight, his eyes on the long legs moving across the stage.

The current head designer for M.Jane was Jane, and the label had been founded by her father. She had evidently inherited his talent, learning design from within the company from childhood.

After taking over the company when her father passed, she had built on the existing aesthetic while introducing her own personal sensibility, giving the brand a new vitality.

Camera flashes kept going off, capturing every clever detail and the beauty of each overall design.

Jiang Qing watched the changing silhouettes of the models with unblinking focus, while running dialogue through his head.

"New Homeland" was about to go into production, and he would be making a cameo as the male lead's close friend. He didn't have many scenes, and if they pushed, it could be wrapped in a few days.

He didn't have Lin Xun's natural intellect. All he had was going over the script as many extra times as it took, and running through his lines whenever a moment opened up. In the most basic things, there was absolutely no room for error.

The media always wrote that after so many years of acting, his dialogue never needed a second take, as though it had been carved into his bones.

That was...... pure rubbish. Could bones really hold that much? It all came from accumulation, from effort, one piece at a time.

After running through the lines once, he mentally flagged the spots where things had caught slightly and needed extra attention, and then played out the key scenes in his mind, seeing what needed to be said, what expression needed to be worn......

He was completely submerged in his own world, and didn't notice anything happening around him.

It was only when the music on the stage paused and the audience started murmuring to each other that he came back. The models had exited, and the final set of the show hadn't begun.

He looked around in confusion and saw that Lin Xun was no longer in his seat. He looked with puzzlement toward Yu Minghan, who shrugged, clearly in the dark too, already settling into full spectator mode.

Just as people were beginning to wonder if something had gone wrong with the show, all the lights in the venue suddenly went dark, and a wave of exclamations came from the women in the crowd.

"Good evening everyone. I'm Jane." A warm female voice came from somewhere, each syllable crisp and rounded with a British English inflection, carrying through the venue's audio system. The chandelier in the center of the ceiling began to glow, and the room gradually quieted.

"This is the surprise I prepared for everyone. Please enjoy."

When the lights came up fully, two grand pianos had been placed at the center of the T-stage, one man and one woman seated facing each other.

The reporters in the back rows erupted. "It's Julie!"

"Who's that man?"

"Lin Xun?!"

Everyone in the venue was stunned at once, both by the appearance of the celebrated pianist Julie and by the sight of an Asian man seated across from her.

There were several domestic artists in the front row, and at this sight, they could not keep down their shock and curiosity.
