This was Jane's show. Julie was performing. Why was Lin Xun up there?

Yu Minghan's eyes went wide, and he looked toward Jiang Qing.

Jiang Qing shrugged in return, the same gesture mirrored back.

Julie was immaculately put-together, spine straight as a rule. She wore a thin chiffon dress, and with a small smile toward Lin Xun, drew the first note down.

After a solo passage, Lin Xun's piano wove in. The two of them played together with natural synchrony. An occasional exchange of glances, fingers moving with fluid ease, and every photographer and media person in the room was testing the limits of their burst-speed shutters.

Julie's speed was widely known. What was unexpected was that Lin Xun kept pace, steady and unhurried, weaving together a piece that seemed to wash through the room.

And with Julie now collaborating with an artist barely a year into his career, curiosity abounded, as did an involuntary sense of wonder at his level of skill, a skill that held its own beside a world-class pianist with no sign of being overshadowed. The two of them blended seamlessly.

When the music reached its peak, it cut off, and then the sound shifted, as though after passing through spring and summer, a golden autumn had finally arrived.

The stage doors opened, and the models walked out one by one wearing the most brilliant designs of the fall and winter collection, and the outfit on Jiang Qing was one of them.

On one side, the breathtaking collection unfolded. On the other, a performance by a pianist you couldn't simply buy a ticket to hear. This fashion show was going to be the most talked-about event of the entire Fashion Week.

Everyone in the room was somewhat undone by it, but kept themselves together. Looking undignified on camera would be unacceptable.

Mu Ning had come to watch the show as well, and stared at Lin Xun with a fixed gaze, feeling something was slightly off without being able to say what.

After some time, she registered that Lin Xun appeared to be smiling toward Julie across from him, and the look in his eyes was too deep, too warm.

Could it be...... that Lin Xun and Julie were in a relationship?

Julie was well into her forties, but she carried herself beautifully, her age invisible, and she had long since climbed to a place most could only admire from a distance. A younger, handsome man in love with her wasn't so surprising.

Just as Mu Ning was turning this over, she caught Lin Xun tilting his head, and realized his gaze didn't seem to be on Julie at all, but was passing over Julie's shoulder to land somewhere in the audience on...... Jiang Qing?

Jiang Qing saw Lin Xun's utterly delighted expression and politely returned a smile. Lin Xun's smile grew even wider.

Jiang Qing: ...... Could you please manage your expressions? Guan Jingshan is going to come after you.

Though he had to admit, Lin Xun at this moment was truly stunning. The MVP of the entire room.

His naturally wavy brown hair had been styled neatly into a side part. His features were vivid and striking. Long lashes moved softly in the stage light.

Upright posture, music like a dream, and tonight he was the face that no camera could look away from.

The last model walked off on the last note. The designer Jane stepped out. She was from a country in Western Europe, with golden-brown hair and eyes, tall and slender. She stopped by the piano and said in English with a warm smile, "Thank you to Julie and Lin for the performance."

Lin Xun rose and embraced her briefly, congratulated her on a successful show, then descended from the stage and returned to his seat.

Julie then played a lighter, more cheerful piece for Jane. In the sound of the piano, Jane began to speak about the design philosophy behind the show. At the end, she took Julie's hand and bent to kiss it. "I love you. You will always be my muse."

Julie stood and embraced her. "You too."

The room erupted.

Was this a public relationship reveal?!

Jiang Qing glanced at Lin Xun with some surprise, and at the confirming nod, looked back at the two women on stage with something close to disbelief.

This show had had more than enough surprises.

Once the event concluded, the reporters headed back to file their pieces, and the brand had arranged a dinner reception, inviting all the artists to attend.

Everyone made their way to the banquet hall in high spirits. This was a chance for close, direct contact. A good impression had to be made.

Jiang Qing had barely stood up when Yu Minghan grabbed him and was already pulling him toward the hall. He looked back a few times and spotted Lin Xun trailing not far behind with a faintly aggrieved expression.

"Slow down. Are you running to catch a flight?" He couldn't stop himself from complaining.

"Oh, I am absolutely in love with this kind of story. Let me go hear about their divine romance." Yu Minghan, entirely unconcerned, dragged him forward at full speed.

Before long, Jane and Julie appeared together in the banquet hall, and immediately a crowd of artists were finding various pretexts to go and talk to them.

Sending congratulations was the most natural opener, and if they seemed welcoming, people would slip in a few questions about their relationship too.

Yu Minghan couldn't push through to the front. He scratched his head. "What do we do? Everything worth saying is already being said. What are we supposed to come up with?"

Jiang Qing gave him a sideways look. "Tell them you came here to eat melon. They'll regard you with entirely new eyes."

"Brilliant!" Yu Minghan's thumb shot up, then he leaned in and quietly recoiled back. "But wait, I just remembered, I'm not great in English. How about you go instead, brother?" And with that, he extended both hands and shoved from behind.

Jiang Qing stumbled forward and found himself standing directly in front of Jane and Julie, and in his mind inflicted a thorough internal beating on Yu Minghan before smiling politely. "Hello. I'm Jiang Qing."

Julie and Jane exchanged a glance laden with meaning, and then looked at him with a friendliness that also carried something rather appraising about it, as though they were looking not quite at him but at a cut of meat on a chopping board.

"That outfit looks wonderful on you." Jane said warmly.

"Thank you. Your brand's pieces are very beautiful, I purchase them regularly." Jiang Qing answered honestly.

Jane smiled, then turned to Julie and murmured something, and no one caught what was said.

A moment later, Julie asked with a smile, "Was there something you wanted to ask?"

From the moment they had arrived, various people had been coming at them from different angles with various questions. When does the new collection come out? How do you choose an ambassador? When is the next world tour? What is your relationship with Lin Xun?

She was genuinely curious what Jiang Qing would ask.

"If I were to ask something......" Jiang Qing looked at her, and when he received an encouraging look in return, said with studied composure, "What was the piece you just performed together called?"

Julie paused, and then burst out laughing. Jane followed right behind her.

The artists nearby, seeing this reaction, exchanged puzzled looks, wondering what on earth Jiang Qing had said to make these two women completely lose their composure.

Jiang Qing himself couldn't figure out which part had been the funny one. Was his question not perfectly reasonable?

After quite a while, Julie laughed and said, "Mr. Jiang is quite interesting. As expected from......"

Before she finished, she noticed Lin Xun standing not far away, with a pretty girl beside him.

She tilted her chin in that direction, and asked with interest, "Mr. Jiang, aren't you curious about my relationship with Lin Xun?"

"I am. So I'll ask him myself later." Jiang Qing answered honestly.

"I see. He's right over there. Off you go." Julie blinked. "Good luck."

Jiang Qing drifted away from the conversation in some confusion, still wondering what exactly he needed luck for.

Though he also couldn't linger too long, to avoid stirring unnecessary resentment in others.

He couldn't find Yu Minghan anywhere, and as he scanned around, he spotted Lin Xun talking and laughing with a woman nearby, whose face looked vaguely familiar.

It took a moment before he placed her. Xu Jiacheng, the second-tier actress who had performed "Boundless" with Lin Xun onstage.

Whatever they were saying, Xu Jiacheng's face had opened into a full smile.

Then Xu Jiacheng seemed to notice something, covered her mouth quickly, said a few words, and moved away from Lin Xun's side.

Jiang Qing reached out and picked up a glass of champagne from a passing server's tray, and turned his head to find another woman now at Lin Xun's side, Mu Ning with her radiant smile directed at Lin Xun.

He stopped where he was, pressed his lips together, and turned to walk back the way he came.

He had barely taken a few steps when a weight settled on his shoulder, and a warm, deep voice came close to his ear. "Where are you going."

The corner of his mouth curved without his permission. He turned his head, and by the time he did, his face had gone back to neutral. "Quite the social butterfly. Flying all around the room."

Lin Xun smiled. "Mm? How long were you watching me?"

"I was not watching you!" He said under his breath, glanced around, wanted to ask something, and didn't know quite how to begin.

"Come with me to meet someone." Lin Xun said with a smile. "You've already seen her, but I'd like to properly introduce you."

"Alright." This was probably going to be Julie.

"Xu Jiacheng came to offer congratulations. Her manager noticed and she was afraid of being made into a CP with me, so she slipped away. She's a decent person." Lin Xun gave the full accounting. "Mu Ning...... what was it she said?"

Jiang Qing looked at him, faintly amused. "Are you serious? A beautiful woman right in front of you and you can't remember what she said? Is there something you're not saying?"

"There is." Lin Xun said honestly.

"......"

Lin Xun pushed open the door to a small lounge, and shortly after, Julie walked in alone.

"Good evening, Mr. Jiang. Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Julie. My given name is Lin Zhuli." Julie said with a warm smile. "I'm Lin Xun's aunt. His father's sister."

Even having guessed there was some kind of connection, he hadn't expected actual family. No wonder Lin Xun had named the Zhuli Arts Center without a second's pause when registering Little Five.

"Hello. I'm Jiang Qing, Lin Xun's friend, neighbor, and business partner." Jiang Qing shook her hand warmly, but noticed Julie's smile falter slightly, and asked, "What is it?"

"Just that?" Julie looked at him for a few seconds, then seemed to arrive at some understanding. She touched Lin Xun's arm. "A-Xun, you actually...... ha ha ha ha."

Lin Xun received her amusement with considerable resignation.

Jiang Qing looked between the two of them, baffled. Julie waved a hand dismissively. "It's nothing. Mr. Jiang is a very interesting person. Lin Xun has always been used to getting his own way. It's rare to see him lose, and it's quite entertaining."

Jiang Qing was even more confused.

"Oh, I also had something I wanted to ask you about." Lin Xun took out his phone, opened a video he had specifically gone to record a few days prior, and held it toward Julie. "This child is named Little Five. She's been learning piano for nearly a month, with no prior exposure to the instrument before that. She's now in the specialized class at your arts center. What do you make of her ability?"

Julie's interest was caught. She took the phone and watched the entire clip, then said, "Not bad at all. She has real potential. I'll have a more specialized teacher assigned to her."

"She's an orphan."

Julie looked at him. "Really?"

"Yes. You and Jane were talking about wanting to adopt a child, weren't you? Would you consider her? She has a good character." Lin Xun suggested. "Of course, just being her student is wonderful too."

"Alright. I'll go see her when I'm next back in the country." Julie exchanged a few more words with him, and then went back out to speak with Jane about it.

Once only the two of them were left in the room, Jiang Qing was quiet for a moment, then said, "Thank Little Five's behalf. Thank you."

"It was nothing. I was helping myself as much as anything. Otherwise she'll keep plotting to have me carry on her legacy. Little Five will give her plenty to occupy herself with."

"Will Julie really adopt her?"

"Hard to say. It depends on Little Five's luck. My aunt and Jane have been together for nearly ten years, and only in the last year or two has this idea come up, but both of them are very busy and haven't had the energy to pursue it."

"Nearly ten years?" Jiang Qing said, a little surprised.

"Yes." Lin Xun looked at him steadily. "Are you envious?"

"Nothing to be envious of. No matter how happy someone else's life is, it's still theirs." Jiang Qing said.

Lin Xun sighed inwardly, and noticed that Jiang Qing kept the door to his heart absolutely locked down, guarded like a fortress, not permitting anyone the smallest foothold.

When the dinner reception ended, the two of them returned to the hotel. Jiang Qing showered and stood on the balcony letting the breeze run through his hair.

Before long, someone appeared on the balcony next door.

Jiang Qing suddenly made a small sound, and turned his head to look at Lin Xun, asking, "What was the piece you and Julie played today called?"

"My Soul. She composed it after falling in love."

"Mm...... and what about yesterday's violin piece?"

Lin Xun paused, then turned sideways to lean against the balcony, and looked at him with full attention. The evening breeze moved through his hair, and there was such a pull to reach out and brush it back into place.

But right now there were several meters of distance between them, and in the future, the distance might yet grow even greater......

Lin Xun was quiet for a moment. Since the other person had built a fortress, then he may as well drop a strike from the sky and bring those walls and that composure both crashing down.

"That piece......" He smiled a little. "Come a little closer. I'm afraid you won't hear me."

Jiang Qing genuinely believed this, and walked to the very end of the balcony, leaning over the railing. "What's it called?"

"It's called...... will you be my boyfriend? Jiang Qing."
